#### 10.2.2 Overall 1149.1 Test Architecture and Operations

In addition to the boundary-scan register described in the previous section, extra control circuitry and data storage are required for each chip. Figure 10.4 shows a chip with the boundary-scan architecture. The internal logic represents the original circuit of the chip. It may contain some internal registers that can be supported by boundary scan, such as scan chains, built-in self-test (BIST) generators or compressors, or any other storage that will make use of the boundary-scan func tionality. The boundary-scan circuitry can be divided into four main hardware components:

除上一节所述的边界扫描寄存器外，每个芯片还需要额外的控制电路和数据存储。图 10.4 展示了一个采用边界扫描架构的芯片。内部逻辑（internal logic）代表芯片的原始电路，其中可能包含一些可由边界扫描提供支持的内部寄存器，例如扫描链、内建自测试（built-in self-test, BIST）生成器或压缩器，以及任何其他将利用边界扫描功能的存储部件。边界扫描电路可划分为四个主要硬件部件：

\- A test access port (TAP), which consists of four mandatory terminals—test data input (TDI), test data output (TDO), test mode select (TMS), and test clock (TCK)—and one optional terminal, test reset (TRST∗)

\- 一个测试访问端口（test access port, TAP），由四个强制性端子——测试数据输入（TDI）、测试数据输出（TDO）、测试模式选择（TMS）与测试时钟（TCK）——以及一个可选端子测试复位（TRST∗）组成

\- A TAP controller (TAPC)

\- 一个 TAP 控制器（TAPC）

\- An instruction register (IR) and its associated decoder

\- 一个指令寄存器（instruction register, IR）及其配套译码器

\- Several test data registers, including the mandatory boundary-scan register and bypass register, and some optional miscellaneous registers, such as the device-ID register, and some design-specific test data registers

\- 若干测试数据寄存器，包括强制性的边界扫描寄存器与旁路（bypass）寄存器，以及一些可选的其他寄存器，例如器件 ID 寄存器（device-ID register）和某些设计专用的测试数据寄存器

The test access port, which defines the bus protocol of the boundary scan, consists of additional I/O pins necessary for each chip employing the standard. The TAP controller is a 16-state, finite-state machine that controls each step of the boundary-scan operations. Each instruction to be carried out by the boundary-scan architecture must be serially loaded into the instruction register through the test data input (TDI) pin. The test signals to configure the boundary-scan-related test hardware for the current test instruction are provided by the associated decoder. The test data registers are used to store test data or some system-related information (such as the chip ID, company name, etc.).

测试访问端口定义了边界扫描的总线协议，由采用该标准的每个芯片所必需的附加 I/O 引脚组成。TAP 控制器是一个 16 状态有限状态机，控制边界扫描操作的每一个步骤。边界扫描架构要执行的每条指令都必须经测试数据输入（TDI）引脚串行载入指令寄存器。针对当前测试指令、用于配置边界扫描相关测试硬件的测试信号由配套译码器提供。测试数据寄存器用于存储测试数据或某些与系统相关的信息（例如芯片 ID、公司名称等）。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_436.jpg>)  
- FIGURE 10.4  
Boundary-scan architecture.
边界扫描架构。

In addition to the hardware components, IEEE Std. 1149.1 also defines a set of test instructions, including four mandatory ones (BYPASS, SAMPLE, PRELOAD, and EXTEST) and several optional ones, including INTEST, RUNBIST, CLAMP, IDCODE, USERCODE, and HIGHZ. It also allows the users to define their own instructions. An outline of a typical test procedure using boundary scan, which will be detailed in the following sections, is as follows:

除硬件部件外，IEEE Std. 1149.1 还定义了一组测试指令，其中包括四条强制性指令（BYPASS、SAMPLE、PRELOAD 和 EXTEST）以及若干可选指令，如 INTEST、RUNBIST、CLAMP、IDCODE、USERCODE 和 HIGHZ。该标准也允许用户自定义指令。使用边界扫描的典型测试流程概要如下，后续小节将对其详细展开：

1. A boundary-scan test instruction is shifted into the IR through the TDI.

1. 一条边界扫描测试指令经 TDI 移入 IR。

2. The instruction is decoded by the decoder associated with the IR to generate the required control signals so as to properly configure the test logic.

2. 该指令由与 IR 配套的译码器译码，生成所需的控制信号，从而正确配置测试逻辑。

3. A test pattern is shifted into the selected data register through the TDI and then applied to the logic to be tested.

3. 一个测试向量经 TDI 移入所选的数据寄存器，然后施加到待测逻辑上。

4. The test response is captured into some data register.

4. 测试响应被捕获到某个数据寄存器中。

5. The captured response is shifted out through the TDO for observation and, at the same time, a new test pattern can be scanned in through the TDI.

5. 捕获到的响应经 TDO 移出以供观测；与此同时，新的测试向量可以经 TDI 扫入。

6. Steps 3 to 5 are repeated until all test patterns are shifted in and applied, and all test responses are shifted out.

6. 重复步骤 3 至 5，直到所有测试向量都已移入并施加、所有测试响应都已移出。

Detailed structures and functions of the boundary-scan components are described next. Figure 10.5 shows an example of the boundary-scan circuitry extracted from Figure 10.4 which provides more detailed information and is used in the following discussion.

下面描述边界扫描各部件的详细结构与功能。图 10.5 给出了从图 10.4 中提取的一个边界扫描电路示例，其中提供了更详细的信息，将用于后续讨论。

#### 10.2.3 Test Access Port and Bus Protocols

The TAP of 1149.1 contains four mandatory pins and one optional pin, as described below:

1149.1 的 TAP 包含四个强制性引脚和一个可选引脚，如下所述：

Test clock input (TCK) is a clock input to synchronize the test operations between the various parts of a chip or between different chips on a PCB. This input must be independent of the system clocks so the serial test data path between components of a chip or different chips can be used independently of the system clocks, which may vary significantly in frequency from one component to another; so the board interconnect testing can be properly carried out; and so the shifting and capturing of test data can be executed concurrently with normal system operation, thereby facilitating online system monitoring for a design without changing the state of the on-chip system logic.

测试时钟输入（TCK）是一个时钟输入，用于同步芯片内各部分之间或 PCB 上不同芯片之间的测试操作。该输入必须独立于系统时钟，以确保：芯片内各组件之间或不同芯片之间的串行测试数据通路可以独立于系统时钟使用，因为系统时钟频率在各组件之间可能相差悬殊；板级互连测试能够正确开展；测试数据的移位与捕获能够与正常系统操作并发执行，从而在不改变片上系统逻辑状态的前提下便于对设计进行在线系统监测。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_437.jpg>)  
- FIGURE 10.5

Test data input (TDI) is an input to allow test instructions and test data to be serially loaded into the instruction register and the various test data registers, respectively. Values presented at TDI are clocked into the selected register on a rising edge of TCK. It is expected that the bus master (automatic test equipment, on-board bus controller, etc.) will change the signal driven to the TDI input on the falling edge of TCK. The design of the circuitry fed from TDI shall be such that an undriven input produces a logical response equivalent to a logic 1.

测试数据输入（TDI）是一个输入端，用于分别将测试指令和测试数据串行载入指令寄存器与各个测试数据寄存器。出现在 TDI 上的数值在 TCK 的上升沿被时钟打入所选的寄存器。总线主控者（bus master，如自动测试设备、板载总线控制器等）应在 TCK 的下降沿改变驱动到 TDI 输入的信号。由 TDI 馈送的电路在设计中应保证：未被驱动的输入会产生等效于逻辑 1 的逻辑响应。

Test data output (TDO) is an output to allow various test data to be driven out. As shown in Figure 10.5, changes in the state of the signal driven through TDO should occur only on the falling edge of TCK. Also, the TDO driver must be set to its inactive driving state except when the scanning of data through this terminal is in progress. The EN block controlled by the Enable signal provides this capability. Note that data should be propagated from TDI to TDO without inversion.

测试数据输出（TDO）是一个输出端，用于将各种测试数据驱动输出。如图 10.5 所示，经 TDO 驱出的信号，其状态变化应只发生在 TCK 的下降沿。此外，除非正在经该端子扫描数据，否则 TDO 驱动器必须被置为非激活的驱动状态。由 Enable 信号控制的 EN 模块提供了这一能力。注意，数据应不经反相地从 TDI 传播到 TDO。

Test mode select (TMS) is the sole test control input to the TAP controller. All boundary-scan test operations such as shifting, capturing, and updating of test data are controlled by the test sequence applied to this input. Signals presented at TMS are sampled by the TAP controller on the rising edge of TCK. It is also expected that the bus master will change the signal driven to the TMS input on the falling edge of TCK. This input should also be driven to logic 1 when it is inactivated.

测试模式选择（TMS）是通向 TAP 控制器的唯一测试控制输入。测试数据的移位、捕获与更新等所有边界扫描测试操作，均由施加到该输入的测试序列控制。出现在 TMS 上的信号由 TAP 控制器在 TCK 的上升沿采样。同样，总线主控者应在 TCK 的下降沿改变驱动到 TMS 输入的信号。该输入在未激活时也应被驱动为逻辑 1。

Test reset (TRST∗) is an optional pin used to reset the TAP controller. If the TRST∗ pin is implemented, the TAP controller can be asynchronously reset to the Test–Logic–Reset controller state (to be discussed later) when a logic “0” is applied at TRST∗. This in turn will reset other boundary-scan logic to the state required by the Test–Logic–Reset state. This pin should not be used to reset the system logic so the test logic can be reset independently of the on-chip system logic. If this input is omitted, the system must have some circuitry that can reset the TAP controller during power-on. In Section 10.2.5, we show that the TAP controller can also be synchronously reset.

测试复位（TRST∗）是一个可选引脚，用于复位 TAP 控制器。如果实现了 TRST∗ 引脚，那么当 TRST∗ 上施加逻辑“0”时，TAP 控制器可以被异步复位到 Test–Logic–Reset 控制器状态（稍后讨论），进而将其他边界扫描逻辑复位到 Test–Logic–Reset 状态所要求的状态。该引脚不应用于复位系统逻辑，以便测试逻辑能够独立于片上系统逻辑进行复位。如果省略该输入，系统必须具备某种能在上电期间复位 TAP 控制器的电路。在 10.2.5 节中我们将说明，TAP 控制器也可以被同步复位。

#### 10.2.4 Data Registers and Boundary-Scan Cells

Standard 1149.1 specifies several test data registers, as shown in Figure 10.5. Two mandatory test data registers—the boundary-scan register and the bypass register— must be included in any boundary-scan architecture. Other registers, such as the device identification register and design-specific test data registers, can be added optionally.

标准 1149.1 规定了若干测试数据寄存器，如图 10.5 所示。其中两个强制性的测试数据寄存器——边界扫描寄存器（BSR，boundary-scan register）和旁路寄存器（bypass register）——必须包含在任何边界扫描架构中。其他寄存器，例如器件标识寄存器（device identification register）和设计专用的测试数据寄存器，则可以按需选用。

The boundary-scan register (BSR) is the collection of the boundary-scan cells (BSCs) inserted at the I/O pins of the original circuit, as shown in Figure 10.4. Various designs for the boundary-scan cells exist. A typical BSC is shown in Figure 10.6. This cell can be used as either an input or output cell. As an input BSC, the IN signal line corresponds to a chip input pad, and the OUT signal line is tied to an input of the internal logic. As an output BSC, IN corresponds to the

边界扫描寄存器（BSR）是插入在原始电路 I/O 引脚处的边界扫描单元（BSC，boundary-scan cell）的集合，如图 10.4 所示。边界扫描单元存在多种设计。一个典型的 BSC 如图 10.6 所示。这种单元既可以用作输入单元，也可以用作输出单元。作为输入 BSC 时，IN 信号线对应芯片的一个输入焊盘，OUT 信号线则连接到内部逻辑的一个输入；作为输出 BSC 时，IN 对应于

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_438.jpg>)

\- FIGURE 10.6

A typical boundary-scan cell (BSC).
典型的边界扫描单元（BSC）。

output of the internal logic, and OUT is tied to an output pad. Data driven on the OUT signal are controlled by the Mode signal. During the normal mode operation -Mode 0, data passes from IN directly to OUT and the cell is transparent to the functional logic. In Test mode -Mode 1, test data driven by the R2 flip-flop pass through the multiplexer to the OUT signal. The test operations of a BSC are controlled by three output signals of the TAP controller: ClockDR, ShiftDR, and UpdateDR (see Figures 10.5 and 10.6). Three main test operations—Capture, Shift, and Update—are defined. In the Capture operation, ShiftDR is set to 0, one clock pulse is applied to ClockDR, and the test data at IN will be captured into the D-FF R1 (known as the capture flip-flop). In the Shift operation, ShiftDR is set to 1 and clock pulses are applied to ClockDR such that test data can be shifted in from SI and the test response can be scanned out through SO. The boundary-scan register is formed by connecting the SO of the previous cell to the SI of the next cell. In the Update operation, the data stored in R1 are propagated to R2 (known as the update flip-flop) by applying a clock pulse to UpdateDR. If the Mode is set to 1 at this time, then the output of R2 is connected to OUT. Note that the Capture and Shif operations can also be executed when the cell is in the normal mode operation, as mentioned in Section 10.2.1. One can also latch test data in R2 (and at the OUT terminal if Mode 1) while other test data are shifted in/out.

内部逻辑的输出，而 OUT 则连接到一个输出焊盘。OUT 信号上驱动的数据由 Mode 信号控制。在正常模式（Mode 为 0）下，数据从 IN 直接传递到 OUT，单元对功能逻辑是透明的。在测试模式（Mode 为 1）下，由 R2 触发器驱动的测试数据经多路选择器传送到 OUT 信号。BSC 的测试操作由 TAP 控制器的三个输出信号控制：ClockDR、ShiftDR 和 UpdateDR（见图 10.5 和图 10.6）。共定义了三种主要测试操作——捕获（Capture）、移位（Shift）和更新（Update）。在捕获操作中，ShiftDR 被置为 0，向 ClockDR 施加一个时钟脉冲，IN 上的测试数据将被捕获进 D 触发器 R1（称为捕获触发器）。在移位操作中，ShiftDR 被置为 1，并向 ClockDR 施加时钟脉冲，使测试数据能从 SI 移入、测试响应能经 SO 扫出。把前一个单元的 SO 连接到下一个单元的 SI，就构成了边界扫描寄存器。在更新操作中，通过向 UpdateDR 施加一个时钟脉冲，把 R1 中存储的数据传播到 R2（称为更新触发器）。若此时 Mode 被置为 1，则 R2 的输出连接到 OUT。注意，如 10.2.1 节所述，单元处于正常模式时也可以执行捕获与移位操作。此外，还可以在其他测试数据移入/移出的同时，把测试数据锁存在 R2 中（若 Mode 为 1，也体现在 OUT 端上）。

Several other scan cell designs exist. Standard 1149.1-2001 defines ten boundary scan cells (BC1–BC10), which include observation-only and bidirectional cells [IEEE 1149.1-2001].

还有其他若干种扫描单元设计。标准 1149.1-2001 定义了十种边界扫描单元（BC1–BC10），其中包括仅观测单元和双向单元 [IEEE 1149.1-2001]。

The bypass register is a single-bit register that is used to bypass a chip when it is not involved in the current test operation. This can significantly reduce test time required to shift in/out test data through the long TDI–TDO path.

旁路寄存器是一个单比特寄存器，用于在某个芯片不参与当前测试操作时将其旁路。这可以显著减少测试数据经由长长的 TDI–TDO 路径移入/移出所需的时间。

Standard 1149.1 also defines an optional data register called the device-ID regis ter, which can be used to load information about the product (the manufacturer, part number, and version number) or the configuration of the chip. The loaded information can be shifted out for observation after the chip is mounted onto a board. One application of this register is to identify during the debugging and diagnosis process the manufacturers and revisions of chips on a board that come from multiple sources.

标准 1149.1 还定义了一种可选的数据寄存器，称为器件标识寄存器，可用于加载产品信息（制造商、部件号和版本号）或芯片的配置信息。在芯片装配到电路板上之后，所加载的信息可以移出供观察。该寄存器的一个应用，是在调试与诊断过程中识别电路板上来自多个供货渠道的芯片的制造商与版本。

#### 10.2.5 TAP Controller

The TAP controller (TAPC) is a 16-state, finite-state machine that operates accord ing to the state diagram shown in Figure 10.7. The TAPC can change state only on the rising edge of TCK. The next state is determined by the logic level of TMS. The output signals of the TAPC determine the test operation to be carried out. As shown in Figure 10.5, nine control signals—ClockDR, ShiftDR, UpdateDR, ClockIR, ShiftIR, UpdateIR, Select, TCK, and Enable—as well as Reset∗ (optional) are produced by the TAPC. The main functions of the TAPC include:

TAP 控制器（TAPC）是一个 16 状态的有限状态机，按照图 10.7 所示的状态图运行。TAPC 只能在 TCK 的上升沿改变状态，下一状态由 TMS 的逻辑电平决定。TAPC 的输出信号决定了要执行的测试操作。如图 10.5 所示，TAPC 产生九个控制信号——ClockDR、ShiftDR、UpdateDR、ClockIR、ShiftIR、UpdateIR、Select、TCK 和 Enable——以及可选的 Reset∗。TAPC 的主要功能包括：

\- Resetting the boundary-scan architecture

\- 复位边界扫描架构

\- Providing control signals to load instructions into the instruction register

\- 提供用于向指令寄存器（instruction register）加载指令的控制信号

\- Providing signals to perform test functions such as Capture and Update (application) of test data

\- 提供用于执行测试功能的信号，例如测试数据的捕获（Capture）与更新（Update，即施加）

\- Providing control signals to shift test data from TDI to TDO

\- 提供将测试数据从 TDI 移位到 TDO 的控制信号

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_439.jpg>)  
- FIGURE 10.7  
State diagram of TAP controller.
TAP 控制器的状态图。

The 16 states can be divided into three parts. The first part (the 2 states at left) contains the reset and the “Run-Test/Idle” states, the second (the 7 states in the middle) and third (the 7 states at right) parts control the operations of the data and instruction registers, respectively. Because the only difference between the second and the third parts is the registers they deal with, only the states in the first and second parts are described in the following text. Details about the third part can be inferred from the descriptions about the second part.

这 16 个状态可以分为三部分。第一部分（左侧的 2 个状态）包含复位状态和“Run-Test/Idle”状态；第二部分（中间的 7 个状态）和第三部分（右侧的 7 个状态）分别控制数据寄存器和指令寄存器的操作。由于第二部分与第三部分的唯一区别在于所处理的寄存器不同，下文只描述第一部分和第二部分中的状态，第三部分的细节可由第二部分的描述推知。

Test–Logic–Reset—In this state the boundary-scan circuitry is disabled and the system operates in its normal mode. Whenever a 0 signal is applied to the TRST∗ port, the TAPC enters this state. One should also notice that the TAPC can also be synchronously reset; whatever state the TAP controller is in, it will return to this state if a logic 1 is applied to TMS for five con secutive TCK cycles (i.e., five rising edges of TCK). It should also be noted that during this state if a glitch occurs at TMS that forces the TAP con troller to enter the Run-Test/Idle state (discussed next), the TAP controller can still return to this state if TMS is kept stable at 1 for the next three TCK cycles.

Test–Logic–Reset（测试逻辑复位）——在该状态下，边界扫描电路被禁用，系统以正常模式工作。只要 TRST∗ 端口上施加 0 信号，TAPC 就会进入该状态。还应注意，TAPC 也可以被同步复位：无论 TAP 控制器处于哪个状态，只要 TMS 连续五个 TCK 周期（即五个 TCK 上升沿）保持逻辑 1，它就会返回该状态。还应指出，在该状态下，若 TMS 上出现迫使 TAP 控制器进入 Run-Test/Idle 状态（下文讨论）的毛刺，只要在随后的三个 TCK 周期内 TMS 保持稳定为 1，TAP 控制器仍可返回该状态。

\- Run-Test/Idle—In this state, the boundary-scan circuitry is waiting for some test operations synchronized with the TCK (such as BIST) to complete. It is different from the Test–Logic–Reset in that during this state activities on selected test logic may still be in progress.

\- Run-Test/Idle（运行测试/空闲）——在该状态下，边界扫描电路正在等待某些与 TCK 同步的测试操作（如 BIST）完成。它与 Test–Logic–Reset 的不同之处在于：在该状态下，所选测试逻辑上的活动可能仍在进行。

\- Select-DR-Scan—This is a temporary state in preparation for entering the data register manipulation column (the middle part) of Figure 10.7.

\- Select-DR-Scan（选择 DR 扫描）——这是一个临时状态，为进入图 10.7 的数据寄存器操作列（中间部分）做准备。

\- Capture-DR—In this state, data can be loaded in parallel to the data registers selected by the current instruction. It is in this state where the current test results and normal operation status are captured.

\- Capture-DR（捕获 DR）——在该状态下，数据可以并行加载到由当前指令所选中的数据寄存器中。正是在该状态下，当前的测试结果和正常工作状态被捕获。

Shift-DR—In this state, test data are scanned in series through the data registers selected by the current instruction. Upon entering this state, the TAP controller will stay in this state as long as TMS 0. For each clock cycle, one bit of test data will be shifted into (out of) the selected data register through TDI (TDO).

Shift-DR（移位 DR）——在该状态下，测试数据经由当前指令所选中的数据寄存器串行扫描。进入该状态后，只要 TMS 为 0，TAP 控制器就停留在该状态。每个时钟周期有一位测试数据通过 TDI（TDO）移入（移出）所选的数据寄存器。

Exit-DR—This is also a temporary state. All parallel-loaded (from the Capture-DR state) or shifted (from the Shift-DR state) data are held in the selected data register in this state in preparation to enter the update or pause state.

Exit-DR（退出 DR）——这也是一个临时状态。在该状态下，所有并行加载（来自 Capture-DR 状态）或移位（来自 Shift-DR 状态）的数据都保存在所选的数据寄存器中，为进入更新或暂停状态做准备。

\- Pause-DR—The boundary-scan logic pauses its function here to wait for some external operations. For example, when a long sequence of test data is to be loaded to the chips under test, the external tester may have to reload the data from time to time. The Pause-DR is a state that allows the boundary-scan architecture to wait for more data to shift in/out.

\- Pause-DR（暂停 DR）——边界扫描逻辑在此暂停其功能，以等待某些外部操作。例如，当要向被测芯片加载一长串测试数据时，外部测试机可能需要不时重新装载数据。Pause-DR 就是一个让边界扫描架构等待更多数据移入/移出的状态。

\- Exit2-DR—This state either indicates completion of the current capturing/shifting operation and allows the TAPC to enter the update state or represents the end of the Pause-DR operation, allowing the TAP controller to go back to the Shift-DR state for more data to shift in/out.

\- Exit2-DR（退出 2 DR）——该状态或者表示当前的捕获/移位操作已完成、允许 TAPC 进入更新状态，或者表示 Pause-DR 操作结束、允许 TAP 控制器返回 Shift-DR 状态以移入/移出更多数据。

Update-DR—In this state, data are latched onto the parallel output of the selected test data registers from the shift register path on the falling edge of TCK; for example, the test data stored in the first stage of boundary-scan cells (R1 in Figure 10.6) are loaded to the second stage (R2) in this state. Note that, with a two-stage register design, test data can be held at the parallel output of the selected register while other data are shifted in the associated shift register path.

Update-DR（更新 DR）——在该状态下，在 TCK 的下降沿，数据从移位寄存器路径锁存到所选测试数据寄存器的并行输出上；例如，边界扫描单元第一级（图 10.6 中的 R1）中存储的测试数据就在该状态下加载到第二级（R2）。注意，采用两级寄存器设计时，当其他数据在相应的移位寄存器路径中移位时，测试数据可以保持在所选寄存器的并行输出上。

#### 10.2.6 Instruction Register and Instruction Set

The instruction register is used to store the instruction to be executed. By the standard, this register must be a two-stage design such that when a new instruction is being shifted in the current instruction can be latched at the parallel output of the IR so as to prevent the possibility of having an indeterminate state at the output of IR. Four mandatory boundary-scan test instructions (SAMPLE, PRELOAD, BYPASS, and EXTEST) are defined in 1149.1. In addition, a commonly used instruction (namely, the INTEST instruction) is recommended. We will describe these instructions in detail. There are other useful instructions, including RUNBIST, CLAMP, IDCODE, USRCODE, and HIGHZ, which will also be described.

指令寄存器（IR）用于存储待执行的指令。标准要求该寄存器必须采用两级设计，使得在移入新指令时，当前指令可以锁存在 IR 的并行输出上，从而避免 IR 输出出现不确定状态的可能。1149.1 定义了四条强制性的边界扫描测试指令（SAMPLE、PRELOAD、BYPASS 和 EXTEST），此外还推荐了一条常用指令（即 INTEST 指令）。我们将详细描述这些指令。还有一些有用的指令，包括 RUNBIST、CLAMP、IDCODE、USERCODE 和 HIGHZ，也将一并描述。

BYPASS—When dealing with board-level testing, it is often required to send test data to or receive test results from only one or two specific chips. The BYPASS instruction is used to “bypass” the boundary-scan registers on unused chips so as to prevent long Shift operations, as shown in Figure 10.8. The BYPASS register must capture a default bit of 0 at the Capture-DR state when this instruction is executed. Furthermore, the instruction register must be forced to contain the BYPASS instruction whenever the TAP is reset, unless an IDCODE instruction (to be discussed later) is implemented, in which case IDCODE is the default instruction to be loaded to the BYPASS register.

BYPASS——在板级（board-level）测试中，常常只需要向一两个特定芯片发送测试数据或从其接收测试结果。BYPASS 指令用于“旁路”未使用的芯片上的边界扫描寄存器，从而避免冗长的移位操作，如图 10.8 所示。执行该指令时，旁路寄存器必须在 Capture-DR 状态捕获一个默认位 0。此外，每当 TAP 被复位时，指令寄存器都必须被强制装入 BYPASS 指令，除非实现了 IDCODE 指令（稍后讨论）；在这种情况下，IDCODE 是装入旁路寄存器的默认指令。

SAMPLE—Figure 10.9 illustrates execution of the SAMPLE instruction. The SAMPLE operation can be completed by simply executing the Capture operation (on the rising edge of TCK in the Capture-DR state) such that the required test data can be loaded in parallel to the selected data registers. This means that a snapshot of the normal operation of the chip can be taken and examined. This instruction also allows the capture of the signals applied to the primary inputs of a chip and capture of the responses appearing at the output of the internal logic. It is required that when the SAMPLE instruction is executed, the operation of the boundary-scan test logic must have no effect on the internal logic or on the flow of signals between the internal logic and the I/O pins of the chip.

SAMPLE——图 10.9 展示了 SAMPLE 指令的执行。SAMPLE 操作只需执行捕获操作（在 Capture-DR 状态于 TCK 上升沿进行）即可完成，使所需的测试数据并行加载到所选的数据寄存器中。这意味着可以对芯片的正常工作拍取一份快照并加以检查。该指令还允许捕获施加到芯片原始输入（primary input）上的信号，以及捕获出现在内部逻辑输出端的响应。要求在执行 SAMPLE 指令时，边界扫描测试逻辑的操作必须对内部逻辑以及对内部逻辑与芯片 I/O 引脚之间的信号流都不产生影响。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_440.jpg>)  
- FIGURE 10.8  
Execution of the BYPASS instruction.
BYPASS 指令的执行。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_441.jpg>)  
- FIGURE 10.9  
Execution of SAMPLE instruction.
SAMPLE 指令的执行。

\- PRELOAD—The PRELOAD instruction allows test data to be shifted into or out of the selected data register during the Shift-DR state without causing interference to the normal operation of the internal logic, as shown in Figure 10.10. The shifted data are then latched to the parallel output (R2) of the selected data registers (on the falling edge of TCK in the Update-DR controller state) for immediate or later use. This allows an initial data pattern to be placed at the latched parallel outputs of boundary-scan register cells using the PRELOAD instruction before the selection of another boundary-scan test operation (say, EXTEST). Without the PRELOAD instruction, indeterminate data would be driven until the following operation, such as a sequence of Shift operations, has been completed.

\- PRELOAD——如图 10.10 所示，PRELOAD 指令允许在 Shift-DR 状态期间把测试数据移入或移出所选的数据寄存器，而不会干扰内部逻辑的正常工作。随后（在 Update-DR 控制器状态的 TCK 下降沿），移位后的数据被锁存到所选数据寄存器的并行输出（R2）上，供立即或稍后使用。这样，在选择另一种边界扫描测试操作（例如 EXTEST）之前，就可以用 PRELOAD 指令把初始数据图案放到边界扫描寄存器单元的锁存并行输出上。如果没有 PRELOAD 指令，在后续操作（如一串移位操作）完成之前，芯片输出将一直驱动不确定的数据。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_442.jpg>)  
- FIGURE 10.10  
Execution of PRELOAD instruction.
PRELOAD 指令的执行。

EXTEST—The EXTEST instruction is used to test the circuitry external to the chips, typically the interconnects between chips and between boards. Its execution is illustrated in Figure 10.11. Assume that an interconnect line from Chip1 to Chip2 as shown is to be tested. First, the test pattern is shifted into the “driving terminals” of Chip1 through its TDI pin during the ShiftDR state of the TAP controller. Second, an Update operation in Chip1 is executed on the falling edge of the TCK such that the shifted test data bit is loaded to the corresponding output pin of Chip1 (similar to the PRELOAD instruction). A Capture operation is then executed in Chip2 on the rising edge of the TCK and the test data bit is captured at the driven terminal of Chip2 (similar to the SAMPLE instruction); therefore, there will be two and a half cycles of latency between the Update operation of Chip1 and the Capture operation of Chip2 if they are controlled by the same TMS. Finally, the ShiftDR operation is executed in Chip2 and the received test response can be scanned out through the TDO of Chip2 for examination. New test patterns can also be shifted in at this time and the cycle can be repeated.

EXTEST——EXTEST 指令用于测试芯片外部的电路，通常是芯片之间以及电路板之间的互连。其执行过程如图 10.11 所示。假设要测试如图所示的从 Chip1 到 Chip2 的一条互连线。第一步，在 TAP 控制器的 Shift-DR 状态期间，测试向量通过 Chip1 的 TDI 引脚移入其“驱动端”；第二步，Chip1 中的更新操作在 TCK 的下降沿执行，把移入的测试数据位加载到 Chip1 相应的输出引脚上（类似于 PRELOAD 指令）；然后，Chip2 中的捕获操作在 TCK 的上升沿执行，测试数据位在 Chip2 的被驱动端被捕获（类似于 SAMPLE 指令）。因此，如果两者由同一个 TMS 控制，Chip1 的更新操作与 Chip2 的捕获操作之间会有两个半周期的延迟。最后，Chip2 执行 Shift-DR 操作，接收到的测试响应可以经 Chip2 的 TDO 扫出供检查。此时也可以移入新的测试向量，并重复该循环。

Based on the above procedure, it can be found that the first two steps can also be accomplished by using the PRELOAD instruction. In fact, before the selection of the EXTEST instruction, data can be loaded onto the latched parallel outputs using PRELOAD. Then, as soon as the EXTEST instruction has been transferred to the parallel output of the instruction register, the preloaded data are driven through the chip output pins. This ensures that the required test data are driven immediately when the change to the EXTEST instruction takes place in the Update-IR controller state, hence preventing the possible appearance of indeterminate data at the chip outputs during the shifting operation if the EXTEST instruction was executed without first executing the PRELOAD instruction.

根据上述过程可以发现，前两个步骤也可以用 PRELOAD 指令完成。实际上，在选择 EXTEST 指令之前，就可以用 PRELOAD 把数据加载到锁存的并行输出上；随后，一旦 EXTEST 指令被传送到指令寄存器的并行输出，预装载的数据就立即经芯片输出引脚驱动出去。这保证了当 Update-IR 控制器状态中发生向 EXTEST 指令的切换时，所需的测试数据被立即驱动，从而避免这样的情况：若不先执行 PRELOAD 就执行 EXTEST 指令，在移位操作期间芯片输出端可能出现不确定的数据。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_443.jpg>)  
Execution of EXTEST instruction.
EXTEST 指令的执行。

Note that in the above description we only examine one interconnect. Clearly, several interconnects can be examined simultaneously. The only requirement is to shift and load the required data bits to the appropriate driv ing positions and then capture these data at the driven positions. The test responses can then be scanned out through the TDO for further examination. Methods to minimize test time for all interconnects can be found in [Jarwala 1989], [Chan 1992], and [Kim 2004].

注意，上述描述只检查了一条互连。显然，多条互连可以同时检查。唯一的要求是：把所需的数据位移入并加载到相应的驱动位置，然后在被驱动位置捕获这些数据；随后测试响应即可经 TDO 扫出做进一步检查。使所有互连的测试时间最小化的方法可参见 [Jarwala 1989]、[Chan 1992] 和 [Kim 2004]。

INTEST—Figure 10.12 shows the steps of the INTEST instruction. During the first step, test data are shifted into the boundary-scan cells that drive internal logic. In the second step, an Update operation is executed and the shifted data are loaded to the second stage of the boundary-scan cell. At the same time the data are applied to the internal logic. The TAP controller then goes back to the Capture-DR state to capture the test result at the boundary-scan cells, which receive data from internal logic. Finally, the Shift-DR operation shifts the test results out for observation. This operation may be repeated for several cycles.

INTEST——图 10.12 展示了 INTEST 指令的步骤。第一步，测试数据被移入驱动内部逻辑的边界扫描单元；第二步，执行一次更新操作，把移位后的数据加载到边界扫描单元的第二级，同时这些数据被施加到内部逻辑上。随后，TAP 控制器回到 Capture-DR 状态，在从内部逻辑接收数据的那些边界扫描单元处捕获测试结果。最后，Shift-DR 操作把测试结果移出供观测。该操作可以重复多个循环。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_444.jpg>)  
Execution of INTEST instruction.
INTEST 指令的执行。

RUNBIST—The RUNBIST instruction provides a means of running a useraccessible self-test function within the chip using a single instruction. This permits all chips on a board that support the RUNBIST instruction to execute their own self-test process concurrently, thereby greatly reducing the total test time. It is also permitted to include further private or public instructions which give access to individual self-test functions one at a time. Because this is an optional instruction, the signals to control the BIST circuitry in each chip have to be generated by user-designed logic. One way to accomplish this is illustrated in Section 10.2.8.

RUNBIST——RUNBIST 指令提供了一种用单条指令启动芯片内用户可访问自测试功能的方法。这使得电路板上所有支持 RUNBIST 指令的芯片能够并发地执行各自的自测试过程，从而大幅缩短总测试时间。也允许再包含一些私有或公开的指令，用于每次访问一个单独的自测试功能。由于这是一条可选指令，控制每个芯片内 BIST 电路的信号必须由用户设计的逻辑产生。10.2.8 节给出了实现这一点的一种方式。

CLAMP—When the CLAMP instruction is executed, the state of all signals driven from the output pins of the chip should be completely defined by the data held in the boundary-scan register, preferably in a “safe” state. The data may be shifted into the boundary-scan register by a previous PRELOAD instruction. It should be pointed out that, similar to the BYPASS instruction, the CLAMP instruction also places only the BYPASS register between TDI and TDO, thus greatly reducing the shift length.

CLAMP——执行 CLAMP 指令时，芯片输出引脚所驱动的所有信号的状态应完全由边界扫描寄存器中保存的数据决定，最好处于“安全”状态。这些数据可以由先前执行的 PRELOAD 指令移入边界扫描寄存器。应当指出，与 BYPASS 指令类似，CLAMP 指令同样只在 TDI 与 TDO 之间放置旁路寄存器，从而大大缩短移位长度。

\- IDCODE—This instruction shall be provided when the optional 32-bit device identification register (device-ID register) is included in the chip. When the IDCODE instruction is used, the vendor’s identification code (containing the manufacturer’s identity, the part number, and the version number of the chip) prestored somewhere in the chip shall be loaded into the device-ID register, which can then be shifted out for examination through the TDI–TDO shif path. This instruction, if implemented, should be the default instruction in the reset state.

\- IDCODE——当芯片中包含可选的 32 位器件标识寄存器（device-ID register）时，应提供该指令。使用 IDCODE 指令时，预先存储在芯片某处的厂商识别码（包含制造商身份、部件号和芯片版本号）会被装入器件标识寄存器，随后可经 TDI–TDO 移位路径移出供检查。若实现了该指令，它应为复位状态下的默认指令。

USERCODE—The USERCODE instruction allows a user-programmable 32- bit identification code to be loaded into the user-defined device-ID register and then shifted out for examination. This instruction is useful when the chip can be programmed in various ways and it is necessary to determine the way in which the chip is programmed. This instruction shall be used in a programmable device such as an FPGA chip if programming the chip via boundary-scan test logic is not allowed. When this instruction is included, it is the responsibility of the chip provider to implement the code somewhere in the chip.

USERCODE——USERCODE 指令允许把用户可编程的 32 位识别码装入用户定义的器件标识寄存器，然后移出供检查。当芯片可以用多种方式编程、且需要确定芯片是以何种方式编程时，该指令很有用。对于 FPGA 芯片这类可编程器件，如果不允许通过边界扫描测试逻辑对芯片编程，则应使用该指令。包含该指令时，在芯片中某处实现该识别码是芯片提供商的责任。

\- HIGHZ—When the HIGHZ instruction is selected for a chip, all output pins of the chip shall be placed in an inactive-drive state. This will allow an in-circuit system tester to drive the chip outputs to some desired state (e.g., to test other chips) without damaging the chip. This instruction also requires that the BYPASS register be the only register on the TDI–TDO path.

\- HIGHZ——当为某个芯片选中 HIGHZ 指令时，该芯片的所有输出引脚都应置于无驱动（inactive-drive）状态。这使在线系统测试机能够把芯片输出驱动到某个期望状态（例如，以测试其他芯片）而不损坏该芯片。该指令同样要求 TDI–TDO 路径上只有旁路寄存器这一个寄存器。

#### 10.2.7 Boundary-Scan Description Language

The boundary-scan description language (BSDL) has been included as part of IEEE Std. 1149.1-2001. This VHSIC hardware description language (VHDL)- compatible language provides information about how a boundary-scan IC is imple mented, which can be used by ATPG software or system integrators to develop the test for the chip. Descriptions for mandatory logic, such as the TAP and BYPASS registers, do not have to be provided. These are already provided in a standard way. The designer only has to describe the design-specific attributes, such as the length of boundary-scan register, the user-defined boundary-scan instructions, the decoder for his or her own instructions, and the I/O pins assignment (e.g., which pin is to be used as the TDI pin). In general these descriptions are quite easy to prepare. Currently, many computer-aided design (CAD) tools already support automatic generation of the boundary-scan design, thus it may not even be necessary for a designer to write the BSDL file; the tools can automatically generate the necessary boundary-scan circuitry as long as the specific boundary-scan information for the chip is provided (in a setup file, for example).

边界扫描描述语言（BSDL，boundary-scan description language）已被纳入 IEEE Std. 1149.1-2001 的一部分。这种与 VHSIC 硬件描述语言（VHDL）兼容的语言提供边界扫描 IC 的实现信息，ATPG 软件或系统集成者可以利用它来开发针对该芯片的测试。强制性逻辑（如 TAP 与旁路寄存器）的描述无须提供，这些内容已按标准方式给出。设计者只需描述设计特有的属性，例如边界扫描寄存器的长度、用户自定义的边界扫描指令、自身指令的译码器以及 I/O 引脚分配（例如，哪个引脚用作 TDI 引脚）。总体而言，这些描述相当容易编写。目前，许多计算机辅助设计（CAD）工具已经支持边界扫描设计的自动生成，因此设计者甚至可能不必亲手编写 BSDL 文件：只要提供了芯片特有的边界扫描信息（例如放在一个设置文件中），工具就能自动生成所需的边界扫描电路。

#### 10.2.8 On-Chip Test Support with Boundary Scan

Standard 1149.1 defines the test circuitry on the boundary of a chip but does not describe how to use boundary-scan circuitry to support the DFT circuitry built inside a chip, such as scan or BIST design. In Figure 10.13 we show a possible way to support these DFT operations. First, we may add new test instructions for these operations such as RUNBIST and RUNSCAN. Second, the decoder for the IR can be designed in such a way that one control line will be added for each new instruction and each time a new instruction is loaded into the IR the corresponding control line will be activated (set to 1, for example). Third, the control line can then be used to enable a decoder specifically designed for the instruction such that the control signals generated by the TAPC can be converted into the appropriate control signals required by the associated DFT circuitry.

标准 1149.1 定义了芯片边界上的测试电路，但没有描述如何利用边界扫描电路来支持芯片内部构建的 DFT 电路，例如扫描设计或 BIST 设计。图 10.13 展示了支持这些 DFT 操作的一种可行方式。第一，可以为这些操作增加新的测试指令，例如 RUNBIST 和 RUNSCAN。第二，IR 译码器可以这样设计：每条新指令对应增加一条控制线，且每当一条新指令装入 IR 时，相应的控制线就被激活（例如被置为 1）。第三，该控制线随后可用于使能一条为该指令专门设计的译码器，把 TAPC 产生的控制信号转换为相关 DFT 电路所需的恰当控制信号。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_445.jpg>)  
Scan and BIST support with boundary scan.
用边界扫描支持扫描与 BIST。

We can use the sample BIST circuitry shown in Figure 10.13 to illustrate this design. When the RUNBIST instruction is loaded into the IR, the mbist signal will be activated and the BIST decoder can be enabled. Initially, the TAP controller is in the Test–Logic–Reset state which will provide a reset signal via the rst signal to reset the BIST controller. If the compressor has to be initialized, we can either reset it or place the TAPC into the shift mode and activate the bist-sel signal such that an initial value can be sent to the Compressor through TDI and bist\_si. Then, we may put the TAPC in the Run-Idle/Test state and enable the BIST controller via the bist\_en signal to start the BIST operation. After the BIST operations are completed, the TAPC is again put into the shift mode so as to shift out the compressed results for evaluation. The hold signal shown in Figure 10.13 can be used to hold the BIST controller when necessary (e.g., waiting for the TAP to reach some required state or waiting for latency testing).

我们可以用图 10.13 所示的示例 BIST 电路来说明这种设计。当 RUNBIST 指令装入 IR 后，mbist 信号将被激活，BIST 译码器随即可以使能。初始时，TAP 控制器处于 Test–Logic–Reset 状态，会经 rst 信号提供复位信号以复位 BIST 控制器。若压缩器需要初始化，既可以复位它，也可以把 TAPC 置于移位模式并激活 bist-sel 信号，使初始值经 TDI 和 bist\_si 送入压缩器。然后，把 TAPC 置于 Run-Idle/Test 状态，并经 bist\_en 信号使能 BIST 控制器以启动 BIST 操作。BIST 操作完成后，再次把 TAPC 置于移位模式，把压缩结果移出供评估。图 10.13 中的 hold 信号可用于在必要时保持 BIST 控制器（例如，等待 TAP 到达某个所需状态，或等待时延测试）。

The above design can be extended to execute BIST for multiple components— concurrently, one by one, or in a mixed manner. Because 1149.1 allows the user to define any number of test instructions, one can define different test instructions if multiple test sessions are required.

上述设计可以扩展为对多个部件执行 BIST——可以并发进行、逐个进行，或以混合方式进行。由于 1149.1 允许用户定义任意数量的测试指令，当需要多轮测试时，可以定义不同的测试指令。

For the scan support, similar mechanisms can be used as shown in Figure 10.13; however, because only one test input (TDI) is available, the test time can be quite long if a single scan chain is used. The test compaction techniques described in Chapter 6, such as broadcast scan, can be used to reduce the test time.

对于扫描支持，可以采用如图 10.13 所示的类似机制；但由于只有一个测试输入（TDI），若使用单条扫描链，测试时间可能相当长。第 6 章所述的测试压缩（test compaction）技术，如广播扫描（broadcast scan），可用于缩短测试时间。

#### 10.2.9 Board and System-Level Boundary-Scan Control Architectures

When the 1149.1 test logic has been successfully integrated into the device, the next problem the designer faces is how to provide test data and control signals to chips on a board or system. There exist several test architectures for this purpose, as shown in Figure 10.14 [Zak 1992] [O’Donnell 1994] [Gibbs 2003] [Treuren 2005]. These are described next.

当 1149.1 测试逻辑成功集成到器件中之后，设计者面临的下一个问题是如何向电路板或系统上的芯片提供测试数据和控制信号。为此已有若干种测试架构，如图 10.14 所示 [Zak 1992] [O’Donnell 1994] [Gibbs 2003] [Treuren 2005]。下面对它们逐一描述。

Single-ring architecture with shared TMS (Figure 10.14a)—In this archi tecture, all boundary-scan registers of chips are daisy-chained together and the TMS signal is broadcast to all chips. All chips will always execute the same Capture, Shift, or Update operation under the control of the TAPC. Note that different chips may still receive different test instructions through the long TDI–TDO chain; for example, some chips may receive the BYPASS instruction while others receive the EXTEST instruction.

共享 TMS 的单环架构（图 10.14a）——在这种架构中，所有芯片的边界扫描寄存器串接成菊花链，TMS 信号广播到所有芯片。在 TAPC 的控制下，所有芯片始终执行相同的捕获、移位或更新操作。注意，各芯片仍可能通过长长的 TDI–TDO 链接收到不同的测试指令；例如，一些芯片可能收到 BYPASS 指令，而另一些芯片收到 EXTEST 指令。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_446.jpg>)  
- FIGURE 10.14

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_447.jpg>)  
Bus master for chips with boundary scan: (a) ring architecture with shared TMS; (b) ring architecture with separate TMS: (c) star architecture: (d) multidrop architecture: (e) hierarchical architecture
带边界扫描芯片的总线主控：(a) 共享 TMS 的环形架构；(b) 独立 TMS 的环形架构；(c) 星形架构；(d) 多点（multidrop）架构；(e) 分层架构

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_448.jpg>)  
(e)

Single-ring architecture with separate TMS (Figure 10.14b)—In this archi tecture, each chip receives its own TMS signal, hence one can provide differ ent instructions to different chips as well as operate the chips with different control signals. With this architecture, virtually all chips can be tested independently. The single-ring architecture is easy to implement. It is generally sufficient to test chips on a single board; however, for a system or back plane that contains a number of boards where each board contains ICs with boundary-scan architectures, the single-ring configuration may become inef ficient due to the long and often cumbersome scan chain that has to pass through all chips in all boards. This architecture also runs into problems when boards are removed or added, as some type of jumper or bridge is required when a board is removed; otherwise, the chain will be broken.

独立 TMS 的单环架构（图 10.14b）——在这种架构中，每个芯片接收自己的 TMS 信号，因此既可以向不同芯片提供不同指令，也可以用不同的控制信号操作各芯片。采用这种架构，几乎所有芯片都可以独立测试。单环架构易于实现，对于测试单块电路板上的芯片通常已经足够；然而，对于包含多块电路板的系统或背板——其中每块板都含有带边界扫描架构的 IC——单环配置可能变得低效，因为冗长且常常笨重的扫描链必须穿过所有板上的所有芯片。当拔除或添加电路板时，这种架构也会遇到问题：拔除一块板时需要某种跳线或桥接，否则链条就会断开。

Star (multi-ring) architecture (Figure 10.14c)—In the star-architecture, every board in the system gets a dedicated set of boundary-scan data and control signals. Though test for chips in each board can be efficiently carried out as if only a single board exists, such an approach requires a larger num ber of (connection) traces in the backplane. The advantage of the ring and star architectures is that they do not require any additional components or new protocols beyond what is required by the boundary-scan specification. This makes them straightforward to implement, but in a large multiple-board system they are often too cumbersome to use.

星形（多环）架构（图 10.14c）——在星形架构中，系统中的每块电路板都得到一组专用的边界扫描数据与控制信号。尽管每块板上芯片的测试可以高效进行，就像只存在单块板一样，但这种做法需要在背板中布置更多的（连接）走线。环形架构与星形架构的优点是：除了边界扫描规范所要求的之外，它们不需要任何额外的部件或新协议。这使得二者实现起来简单直接，但在大型多板系统中往往因过于笨重而难以使用。

Multidrop architecture (Figure 10.14d)—A multidrop architecture uses only one set of 1149.1 data and control signals which is wired in parallel to each board in the system. To ensure that boundary-scan operations are applied to only one board at a time, an addressable gateway device must be implemented on each board. A special selection protocol is applied to the boundary-scan bus by the system-level boundary-scan controller to connect the chosen board’s scan chain to the bus. This solves the problems mentioned above at the expense of extra selection logic in each board. The multidrop architecture is the one used most in industry; for example, the Addressable Shadow Port developed by Texas Instruments (TI) [Whetsel 1992] [Joshi 2003] [TI 1999] [TI 2003] and the Scan-Bridge developed by National Semiconductor (NS) [NS 2004a] [NS 2004b] belong to this category.

多点架构（图 10.14d）——多点架构只用一套 1149.1 数据与控制信号，以并联方式接线到系统中的每块电路板。为确保边界扫描操作一次只施加于一块电路板，每块板上必须实现一个可寻址的网关器件。系统级（system-level）边界扫描控制器向边界扫描总线施加一种专门的选择协议，把所选板的扫描链连接到总线上。这解决了上述问题，代价是每块板上需要额外的选择逻辑。多点架构是业界使用最多的架构；例如，Texas Instruments（TI）开发的可寻址影子端口（Addressable Shadow Port）[Whetsel 1992] [Joshi 2003] [TI 1999] [TI 2003] 和 National Semiconductor（NS）开发的 Scan-Bridge [NS 2004a] [NS 2004b] 都属于这一类。

Hierarchical architecture (Figure 10.14e)—A hierarchical connection is essentially a nested test structure, as shown in Figure 10.14e. This architec ture has the following advantages: For a complex system the bit length of the serial scan path can become quite large. By breaking the single chains into multiple hierarchical chains, chip access can become much more efficient. The hierarchical structure is also helpful when performing system-level test integration because a complex system is often designed in a top-down fashion which naturally bears a hierarchical structure. The hierarchical architecture can be implemented together with a multidrop system such that the scan path of one board can be used to drive another entire level of multidrop test, as shown in Figure 10.14e.

分层（hierarchical）架构（图 10.14e）——分层连接本质上是一种嵌套的测试结构，如图 10.14e 所示。该架构有以下优点：对复杂系统而言，串行扫描路径的位长可能变得很大；把单一链条拆分为多条分层链，芯片访问的效率可以大幅提高。分层结构还有助于执行系统级测试集成，因为复杂系统通常按自顶向下的方式设计，天然带有分层结构。分层架构还可以与多点系统一起实现，使一块板的扫描路径用于驱动整个另一层级的多点测试，如图 10.14e 所示。

All of the above-mentioned architectures use the boundary-scan protocol for board or system testing with at least four dedicated lines required. Methods to test chips by using a simplified bus and protocol not compliant to the 1149.1 standard have also been proposed [Backstrom 2005]. The motivation behind such designs lies in the fact that usually embedded go/no-go and efficient local diagnosis are crucial in order to quickly identify and diagnose problems in a system; therefore the information to be transferred at the backplane level can be as simple as the initialization of a test procedure and the go/no-go report of the test results. The solution presented in [Backstrom 2005] belongs to this category and requires only two wires in the backplane.

上述所有架构在进行板级或系统级测试时都使用边界扫描协议，至少需要四条专用线。也有人提出了使用不符合 1149.1 标准的简化总线和协议来测试芯片的方法 [Backstrom 2005]。这类设计背后的动机在于：为了快速识别和诊断系统中的问题，嵌入式的通过/不通过（go/no-go）判定与高效的本地诊断通常至关重要；因此，在背板层面需要传递的信息可以简单到只是一次测试流程的启动和测试结果的通过/不通过报告。[Backstrom 2005] 提出的方案即属此类，且在背板中只需要两根线。

### 10.3 BOUNDARY SCAN FOR ADVANCED NETWORKS (IEEE 1149.6)

#### 10.3.1 Rationale for 1149.6

As serial data I/O have increased to multiple-gigabit-per-second rates, advanced signaling techniques such as differential and AC-coupled networks have begun to emerge. These signaling techniques present significant challenges for the IEEE 1149.1 standard [IEEE 1149.1-2001]. The presence of the coupling capacitor in AC-coupled networks blocks DC signals. As a result, the DC level that is applied to the net during a boundary-scan EXTEST instruction decays over time to an undefined logic level. This is shown in Figure 10.15 [IEEE 1149.6-2003], where $\ " { } \mathbf { C } ^ { \prime }$ and $ { { } ^ { \omega } \mathrm { U } } ^ { \prime \prime }$ refer to the 1149.1 Capture logic (R1 flip-flop in Figure 10.6) and Update logic (R2 flip-flop in Figure 10.6), respectively. In this case, the Capture-DR state must occur within a minimum time after driving the signal in the Update-DR state. This in turn places a minimum frequency requirement on TCK that cannot be supported by the 1149.1 standard. The IEEE 1149.6 standard addresses this issue by capturing the edges of data transitions instead of capturing data levels. By capturing edges instead of levels, the minimum TCK frequency requirement is removed.

随着串行数据 I/O 的速率提升到每秒数吉比特量级，差分网络与 AC 耦合（AC-coupled）网络等先进信号技术开始出现。这些信号技术给 IEEE 1149.1 标准带来了重大挑战 [IEEE 1149.1-2001]。AC 耦合网络中耦合电容的存在会阻断直流（DC）信号。因此，在边界扫描 EXTEST 指令期间施加到网络上的直流电平会随时间衰减到未定义的逻辑电平。如图 10.15 [IEEE 1149.6-2003] 所示，其中 $\ " { } \mathbf { C } ^ { \prime }$ 与 $ { { } ^ { \omega } \mathrm { U } } ^ { \prime \prime }$ 分别指 1149.1 的捕获逻辑（图 10.6 中的 R1 触发器）与更新逻辑（图 10.6 中的 R2 触发器）。在这种情况下，Capture-DR 状态必须发生在 Update-DR 状态驱动信号之后的限定时间内。这又对 TCK 提出了最低频率要求，而 1149.1 标准无法支持这一要求。IEEE 1149.6 标准通过捕获数据跳变的边沿而非数据电平来解决这一问题。由于捕获的是边沿而非电平，TCK 最低频率要求便不复存在。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_449.jpg>)  
- FIGURE 10.15

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_450.jpg>)

In addition to AC-coupling, differential signaling presents problems for the 1149.1 standard because of its fault tolerance. Standard 1149.1 specifies two ways to address differential networks:

除 AC 耦合之外，差分信号还因其容错特性而给 1149.1 标准带来问题。标准 1149.1 规定了两种处理差分网络的方式：

\- Placing boundary cells on both outputs of the driver and both inputs of the receiver

\- 在驱动端的两个输出和接收端的两个输入上都放置边界扫描单元

\- Placing a single boundary cell attached internally to the driver and another boundary cell internally to the receiver (see Figure 10.16)

\- 在驱动端内部连接一个边界扫描单元，并在接收端内部连接另一个边界扫描单元（见图 10.16）

Only the second choice is practical for high-speed networks, as the boundary cells would present an unreasonable load to the high-speed driver. Herein lies the problem. With only a single boundary-scan cell connected to the output of the differential receiving buffer, opens on either of the input pins may not be detected due to the fault-tolerant nature of differential receivers. An open on one of the two input pins will most likely result in that input to the receiver buffer being terminated to a bias or threshold voltage. Assuming that the other input pin is connected, the boundary-scan cell will still detect the correct state of the network. While these faults are undetectable during a boundary-scan test, they will certainly cause failures during operation at functional speeds.

对于高速网络而言，只有第二种选择切实可行，因为边界扫描单元会给高速驱动端带来不合理的负载。问题正出在这里。当差分接收缓冲器的输出端只连接一个边界扫描单元时，由于差分接收器的容错特性，任一输入引脚上的开路故障都可能无法被检测到。两个输入引脚之一发生开路时，最可能出现的情况是：接收缓冲器的该路输入被端接到某个偏置电压或阈值电压上。假定另一个输入引脚仍然连接正常，边界扫描单元仍会检测到网络的正确状态。这些故障虽然在边界扫描测试期间无法检测，但在功能速度下的实际运行中必然会导致失效。

A better boundary-scan circuit would consist of a single cell internal to the driver and a boundary-scan cell on each input of the receiver. There is little performance penalty on the driver side and better coverage on the receiver side. This circuit can be implemented without violating the 1149.1 standard; however, the standard does not discuss this implementation, and most 1149.1 tools do not recognize such a configuration. This is the implementation that IEEE 1149.6 uses for differentia networks.

更好的边界扫描电路应当是：驱动端内部只放一个单元，而在接收端的每个输入上各放一个边界扫描单元。这样，驱动端一侧几乎没有性能损失，接收端一侧则获得更好的覆盖率。这种电路可以在不违反 1149.1 标准的前提下实现；然而，该标准并未讨论这种实现方式，大多数 1149.1 工具也不识别这种配置。这正是 IEEE 1149.6 为差分网络采用的实现方式。

The following sections describe the four key components of the IEEE 1149.6 circuit: (1) analog test receiver, (2) digital driver logic, (3) digital receiver logic, and (4) 1149.6 TAP. The analog test receiver and digital receiver logic replace the Rx side boundary-scan logic shown in Figure 10.15. The digital driver logic replaces the Tx side boundary-scan logic shown in Figure 10.15.

下面几节描述 IEEE 1149.6 电路的四个关键部件：（1）模拟测试接收端（analog test receiver）；（2）数字驱动端逻辑（digital driver logic）；（3）数字接收端逻辑（digital receiver logic）；（4）1149.6 测试访问端口（TAP）。模拟测试接收端和数字接收端逻辑取代图 10.15 中所示 Rx 侧的边界扫描逻辑，数字驱动端逻辑则取代图 10.15 中所示 Tx 侧的边界扫描逻辑。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_451.jpg>)

- FIGURE 10.16

The IEEE 1149.1 configuration for differential signaling.

IEEE 1149.1 用于差分信号的配置。

#### 10.3.2 1149.6 Analog Test Receiver

The analog test receiver is the most critical part of the 1149.6 implementation. It is the test receiver that is able to capture transition edges (as described above). The challenge for the test receiver is to capture the edges without the noise immunity that is built into the differential receiver (as there is a test receiver on each input pin). The test receiver uses a “self-referenced” comparator, along with voltage and delay hysteresis, to capture a valid edge and filter any unwanted noise. The test receiver uses a low-pass filter to create a delayed reference signal. An example of the test receiver and its response to AC- and DC-coupled signals is shown in Figure 10.17.

模拟测试接收端是 1149.6 实现中最关键的部分。正是这个测试接收端能够捕获跳变边沿（如前文所述）。测试接收端面临的挑战在于：它要在不具备差分接收器内置噪声抑制能力的情况下捕获边沿（因为每个输入引脚上都有一个测试接收端）。测试接收端采用“自参考”（self-referenced）比较器，配合电压迟滞与延迟迟滞，来捕获有效边沿并滤除一切不必要的噪声。测试接收端利用低通滤波器产生一个延迟的参考信号。测试接收端及其对 AC 耦合与 DC 耦合信号的响应示例见图 10.17。

#### 10.3.3 1149.6 Digital Driver Logic

The 1149.6 digital driver logic is a simple extension to the IEEE 1149.1 driver. Unlike the 1149.1 driver, the 1149.6 driver is required to drive a pulse (or a sequence of pulses) when it is executing the 1149.6 EXTEST\_PULSE (or EXTEST\_TRAIN) instruction. The EXTEST\_PULSE instruction is used to drive the output signal to the opposite state, wait for the signal to fully decay, and then drive the signal to the correct value (this is the value that gets captured). By allowing the signal to fully decay, the maximum voltage swing is generated on the next driven edge, allowing for better capture by the analog test receiver. In rare cases, a continuous waveform may be required for some high-speed logic. In this case, the EXTEST\_TRAIN instruction is used instead of the EXTEST\_PULSE. EXTEST\_TRAIN will generate a continuous waveform based on TCK. The TCK frequency must be adjusted to allow for maximum decay without affecting the receiver side logic. The digital driver logic must also support the 1149.1 EXTEST instruction. It simply extends the 1149.1 logic by multiplexing the 1149.6 signal into the 1149.1 shift/update circuit, after the update flip-flop (see Figure 10.18). The 1149.6 driver logic is selected by setting the AC Mode signal to a logic 1. The AC Mode signal is a new signal generated by the TAPC in response to an EXTEST\_PULSE or EXTEST\_TRAIN instruction. RTI state is also a new signal required for 1149.6. This signal is driven by the TAPC when the controller is in the Run-Test/Idle state while executing an EXTEST\_PULSE or EXTEST\_TRAIN instruction. The additional logic required for 1149.6 is circled in the figure.

1149.6 数字驱动端逻辑是对 IEEE 1149.1 驱动端的简单扩展。与 1149.1 驱动端不同，1149.6 驱动端在执行 1149.6 的 EXTEST\_PULSE（或 EXTEST\_TRAIN）指令时，必须驱动一个脉冲（或脉冲序列）。EXTEST\_PULSE 指令先把输出信号驱动到相反状态，等待信号充分衰减，然后把信号驱动到正确的值（被捕获的正是这个值）。允许信号充分衰减，可以在下一个驱动边沿上产生最大的电压摆幅，从而使模拟测试接收端更容易捕获。在少数情况下，某些高速逻辑可能需要连续波形。此时改用 EXTEST\_TRAIN 而非 EXTEST\_PULSE。EXTEST\_TRAIN 会产生基于 TCK 的连续波形。TCK 频率必须加以调整，以便达到最大衰减，同时不影响接收端一侧的逻辑。数字驱动端逻辑还必须支持 1149.1 的 EXTEST 指令。它只是把 1149.6 信号复用到 1149.1 的移位/更新电路中、位于更新触发器之后（见图 10.18），以此对 1149.1 逻辑加以扩展。把 AC Mode 信号置为逻辑 1 即可选中 1149.6 驱动端逻辑。AC Mode 信号是 TAPC（TAP 控制器）响应 EXTEST\_PULSE 或 EXTEST\_TRAIN 指令而产生的一个新信号。RTI state 信号同样是 1149.6 所需的一个新信号：当控制器在执行 EXTEST\_PULSE 或 EXTEST\_TRAIN 指令期间处于 Run-Test/Idle 状态时，该信号由 TAPC 驱动。1149.6 所需的附加逻辑已在图中圈出。

#### 10.3.4 1149.6 Digital Receiver Logic

The digital receiver logic (with the analog test receiver) is shown in Figure 10.19. The digital receiver logic takes the output of the analog test receiver and sets a capture flip-flop to a corresponding logical zero or one. The digital test receiver logic also ensures that a valid transition has been captured on every test vector by initializing the state of the capture memory prior to the transition being driven onto the net (this element is shown as the “hysteresis memory,” or Hyst Mem). Without this initialization, it would be impossible to determine if two sequentia

transitions in the same direction (positive or negative) occurred or if only one transition occurred; that is, if a positive transition occurs and is captured in the memory, and the subsequent test vector also generates a positive transition, then there is no way to determine if the second transition occurred without clearing the contents of the hysteresis memory before the second transition occurs. 同一方向（正向或负向）的跳变，还是只出现过一次跳变；也就是说，如果一个正向跳变发生并被存入存储器，而随后的测试向量又产生一个正向跳变，那么若不在第二次跳变发生之前清除迟滞存储器的内容，就无法判定第二次跳变是否发生过。捕获存储器用移入捕获触发器的数据内容进行初始化。存储器依据模拟测试接收端检测到的跳变被置位或清除。随后，在 Capture-DR 状态期间与 TCK 上升沿相对应的时刻，捕获存储器被装入捕获触发器。

#### 10.3.5 1149.6 Test Access Port (TAP)

Changes were made to the 1149.1 TAP to allow the 1149.6 driver logic to generate pulses. It was determined that the 1149.6 TAP would require an excursion through the Run-Test/Idle state to allow for the generation of the pulse or pulses required by the EXTEST\_PULSE and EXTEST\_TRAIN instructions. Entry into the Run-Test/Idle state during the execution of either EXTEST\_PULSE or EXTEST\_TRAIN would generate the AC Test signal, which was shown in Figure 10.18 (1149.6 Driver). This would in turn cause the data that were driven onto the net during the Update-DR state to be inverted upon entry into the Run-Test/Idle state (on the first falling edge of TCK) and to be inverted again upon exiting Run-Test/Idle (on the first falling edge of TCK in the Select-DR state). As mentioned previously, the data signa is inverted and then allowed to fully decay in order to guarantee the maximum transition from the driver. This behavior is shown in Figure 10.20.

人们对 1149.1 TAP 作了修改，使 1149.6 驱动端逻辑能够产生脉冲。所得结论是：1149.6 TAP 需要途经 Run-Test/Idle 状态，以便产生 EXTEST\_PULSE 和 EXTEST\_TRAIN 指令所需的一个或多个脉冲。在执行 EXTEST\_PULSE 或 EXTEST\_TRAIN 期间进入 Run-Test/Idle 状态，会产生 AC Test 信号，该信号已在图 10.18（1149.6 驱动端）中示出。这进而会使 Update-DR 状态期间驱动到网络上的数据，在进入 Run-Test/Idle 时（于 TCK 的第一个下降沿）被反相，并在退出 Run-Test/Idle 时（于 Select-DR 状态中 TCK 的第一个下降沿）再次被反相。如前所述，数据信号先被反相，然后充分衰减，以保证驱动端产生最大的跳变。这一行为如图 10.20 所示。
