Driver behavior during EXTEST\_PULSE instruction.

执行 EXTEST\_PULSE 指令期间的驱动端行为。

#### 10.3.6 Summary

The IEEE 1149.6 standard is an extension of the IEEE 1149.1 standard. The 1149.6 standard must comply with all 1149.1 rules. The 1149.6 logic allows for testing of AC-coupled networks by capturing edges of pulses that are generated by 1149.6 drivers. A special analog test receiver is used to capture these edges. The 1149.6 receiver logic is placed on both inputs of the differential receiver logic. Special hysteresis logic filters out noise and captures only valid transitions. These extensions allow for an equivalent level of testing (to 1149.1) for high-speed digital interconnects.

IEEE 1149.6 标准是 IEEE 1149.1 标准的扩展。1149.6 标准必须遵守 1149.1 的全部规则。1149.6 逻辑通过捕获 1149.6 驱动端所产生的脉冲边沿，使 AC 耦合网络可被测试。捕获这些边沿采用一个专用的模拟测试接收端。1149.6 接收端逻辑放置在差分接收端逻辑的两个输入上。专用的迟滞逻辑滤除噪声，只捕获有效跳变。这些扩展使高速数字互连能够获得与 1149.1 同等的测试水平。

### 10.4 EMBEDDED CORE TEST STANDARD (IEEE Std. 1500)

#### 10.4.1 SOC (System-on-Chip) Test Problems

As shown in Figure 10.1, a typical SOC design may contain a large number of cores. The relationship between cores and SOCs appears to be analogous to that between chips and boards/systems; hence, a test architecture similar to a boundary scan should also be highly desirable for SOC testing. Many concepts developed for boundary scan have indeed been applied to SOC testing; however, a major difference exists between core-based SOC testing and chip-based board/system testing. The components in the latter are chips that have been manufactured and tested before they are put on a board; thus, the main test problem for the system integrator is the interconnects between chips on a board and between boards in a system. For SOC testing, all cores are not manufactured before they are integrated into an SOC. It is the responsibility of the system integrator to test all of the cores, as well as the interconnects, after the chips are manufactured. Many test problems arise, as discussed below [Zorian 1997] [Cheng 2001].

如图 10.1 所示，一个典型的片上系统（SOC，system-on-chip）设计可能包含大量的核（core）。核与 SOC 之间的关系看上去类似于芯片与电路板/系统之间的关系；因此，类似边界扫描的测试架构对 SOC 测试来说也应当是非常理想的。为边界扫描开发的许多概念确实已被应用到 SOC 测试中；然而，基于核的 SOC 测试与基于芯片的电路板/系统测试之间存在一个重大差异：后者的组成部分是芯片，这些芯片在被装上电路板之前已经制造并测试完毕；因此，对系统集成商而言，主要的测试问题是电路板上芯片之间以及系统内电路板之间的互连。而对 SOC 测试来说，各核在被集成到 SOC 中之前并非都已制造完成。在芯片制造出来之后，测试所有的核以及互连是系统集成商的职责。这就产生了许多测试问题，下文将逐一讨论 [Zorian 1997] [Cheng 2001]。

Mixing technologies—An SOC may contain cores with logic, processor, memory, and analog design/manufacturing technologies. All of these cores must be tested after the SOC is manufactured. It is almost impossible for a system integrator to develop all the tests alone. Assistance from the core providers must be enforced, and a standard way to communicate between the core providers and the system integrator must be established.

工艺混合——一个 SOC 可能包含采用逻辑、处理器、存储器和模拟等不同设计/制造工艺的核。所有这些核都必须在 SOC 制造完成之后进行测试。系统集成商几乎不可能独自开发全部测试。必须强制取得核提供方的协助，并建立核提供方与系统集成商之间沟通的标准方式。

\- Deeply embedded cores—A core may be deeply embedded in a chip. This requires some kind of test access mechanism (TAM) through which the core can be efficiently accessed and tested. It is preferred that the cores to be integrated have a plug-and-play feature under the TAM so as to make system integration manageable.

\- 深度嵌入的核——核可能深深嵌入芯片内部。这就需要某种测试访问机制（TAM，test access mechanism），借助它高效地访问和测试该核。最好是被集成的核在 TAM 之下具备即插即用（plug-and-play）特性，从而使系统集成工作易于管理。

Hierarchicalcores—Acoreitselfmaycontainsomecoresinahierarchicalmanner. A TAM only for cores at the top level of a hierarchy is insufficient. An efficient and effective hierarchical test structure is needed to test the cores at the lower level of a hierarchy. It is also desired that the plug-and-play feature can be carried out for cores at any hierarchical level to simplify the integration work.

层次化核——一个核本身可能以层次化的方式包含另一些核。仅有面向层次结构顶层核的 TAM 是不够的。要测试层次结构较低层级的核，需要一种高效且有效的层次化测试结构。同时还希望即插即用特性能在任意层次级别上对核实现，以简化集成工作。

\- Different core providers—Cores may come from different vendors. The cores available to the system integrator may be soft cores, hard cores, or firm cores. The integrator needs to know how to test these cores after putting them together. Some kind of design and test standard is again essential for the integration purpose.

\- 核提供方不同——核可能来自不同的供应商。系统集成商可获得的核可能是软核（soft core）、硬核（hard core）或固核（firm core）。集成商需要知道在把它们组装到一起之后如何测试这些核。要实现集成，某种设计与测试标准同样是必不可少的。

\- IP protection/test reuse—Detailed internal structural information of a core is usually unavailable due to IP protection considerations. It is thus desirable to be able to reuse the test provided by the core developer with very limited or no modifications. A standard core test interface and protocol are also essential to address this problem.

\- IP 保护/测试复用——出于 IP 保护的考虑，通常无法获得核的详细内部结构信息。因此，人们希望能够在极少修改甚至不作修改的情况下复用核开发者提供的测试。要解决这一问题，标准的核测试接口与协议同样必不可少。

Higher performance core I/Os than SOC pins—The clock rate inside a core can be significantly higher than what can be provided from SOC pins; for example, many contemporary CPUs are running multiple-gigahertz clocks while their chip I/Os are still limited to the range of hundreds of megahertz. Test clocks provided from external testers usually cannot support at-speed testing even if the core can be isolated and well accessed through some TAM. Raising the test clock rate using a dedicated phase-lock loop would signifi cantly complicate the design, resulting in unacceptable test costs. In this case, employing normal functional units to create the required at-speed test envi ronment seems to be the only way to achieve efficient, effective, and economic testing.

核 I/O 的性能高于 SOC 引脚——核内部的时钟速率可能显著高于 SOC 引脚所能提供的速率；例如，当代许多 CPU 运行在数吉赫兹的时钟上，而其芯片 I/O 仍局限于数百兆赫兹的范围。即使核可以通过某种 TAM 被隔离并良好访问，由外部测试机提供的测试时钟通常也无法支持全速（at-speed）测试。利用专用锁相环提高测试时钟速率会使设计显著复杂化，导致不可接受的测试成本。在这种情况下，采用普通功能单元来营造所需的全速测试环境，似乎是实现高效、有效且经济的测试的唯一途径。

\- Expensive and inefficient external automatic test equipment (ATE)—The specifications of ATE for testing digital, analog, and memory devices are significantly different. If the SOC testing relies solely on external ATE, then the ATE must be capable of generating/examining all types of test signals and hence will be extremely expensive. Moving some test control or test data generation mechanism into the chip can potentially reduce the use of externa ATE and reduce the test cost.

外部自动测试设备（ATE，automatic test equipment）昂贵且低效——用于测试数字、模拟和存储器件的 ATE，其技术规格差别很大。如果 SOC 测试完全依赖外部 ATE，那么该 ATE 必须能够生成/检验所有类型的测试信号，因而会极其昂贵。把一部分测试控制或测试数据生成机制移入芯片内部，有望减少外部 ATE 的使用并降低测试成本。

\- Long test application time—Clearly, long test application time is required if the cores in an SOC are tested sequentially. This will worsen the already acute problem of the extremely high cost of ATE. Moreover, this may seriously affect the time-to-market, resulting in disastrous market loss. Parallel testing or test scheduling is necessary to reduce test time and hence the adverse effects described above.

\- 测试应用时间长——显然，如果 SOC 中的核逐一顺序测试，就需要很长的测试应用时间。这会使 ATE 成本极高这一本已尖锐的问题进一步恶化。此外，它还可能严重影响上市时间，造成灾难性的市场损失。必须采用并行测试或测试调度来缩短测试时间，从而减轻上述不利影响。

\- Large test power—While great efforts have been devoted to low power design, test power issues have only recently gained attention. While parallel testing of as many cores as possible is desired to reduce test time, excess test power resulting in incorrect test results or even damaging the devices under test is possible. A test schedule must be carefully planned so as not to violate any constraint or limit of test power.

\- 测试功耗大——尽管人们在低功耗设计上已投入巨大努力，测试功耗问题也只是最近才受到关注。为了缩短测试时间，人们希望尽可能多的核并行测试，但过大的测试功耗可能导致测试结果不正确，甚至损坏被测器件。必须仔细规划测试调度，以免违反测试功耗方面的任何约束或限制。

\- Testable design automation—As SOC testing involves many new compli cated problems, new DFT insertion tools that solve these problems are highly desirable. These tools should include the automatic generation of standard test circuitry, test architecture, and test plan or schedule. Test pattern generation and formatting are also necessary for test reuse.

\- 可测性设计自动化——由于 SOC 测试涉及许多新的复杂问题，人们非常需要能够解决这些问题的新型 DFT 插入工具。这些工具应包括标准测试电路、测试架构以及测试计划或调度的自动生成。测试向量（test pattern）的生成与格式化对测试复用同样必不可少。

Many of the above problems strongly suggest that a standard be established such that core developers and system integrators can communicate efficiently to address issues of SOC testing. Other problems require a good test plan or schedule to carry out actual test procedures as efficiently as possible while maintaining the integrity of the test. The inefficiency and ineffectiveness of the external ATE also have to be dealt with to prevent testing from becoming the bottleneck of SOC industry. In this section, we focus on the standard for core-based testing.

上述许多问题都强烈表明，应当建立一个标准，使核开发者与系统集成商能够高效沟通，从而处理 SOC 测试的各项问题。另一些问题则需要良好的测试计划或调度，以便在保持测试完整性的同时，尽可能高效地执行实际测试流程。外部 ATE 低效无效的问题也必须加以解决，以免测试成为 SOC 产业的瓶颈。本节重点讨论基于核的测试标准。

Standard 1500 is a test standard approved by IEEE in 2005 which inherits most of the properties of 1149.1 and can further address many of the SOC test problems described above. The main goal of 1500 is to standardize a core test architecture by defining a core test interface between an embedded core and the system so as to facilitate test reuse for embedded cores through core access mechanisms, provide testability for system interconnect and user-defined logic (UDL), and enable core test with plug-and-play (PnP) protocols. The IEEE 1500 standard supports both serial and parallel test access mechanisms and provides a rich set of instructions for core and interconnect testing. It also defines features that enable core isolation and protection. A system chip complying with 1500 should contain the following hardware components:

标准 1500 是 IEEE 于 2005 年批准的一项测试标准，它继承了 1149.1 的大部分特性，并能进一步解决上文所述的许多 SOC 测试问题。1500 的主要目标是通过在嵌入式核与系统之间定义核测试接口来标准化核测试架构，以便借助核访问机制促进嵌入式核的测试复用，为系统互连和用户自定义逻辑（UDL，user-defined logic）提供可测性，并通过即插即用（PnP，plug-and-play）协议实现核测试。IEEE 1500 标准同时支持串行和并行测试访问机制，并为核测试与互连测试提供了一整套丰富的指令。它还定义了实现核隔离与核保护的特性。符合 1500 的系统芯片应包含以下硬件部件：

\- One standard test wrapper for each core

\- 每个核一个标准测试外壳（wrapper）

\- Signal sources and sinks for test pattern provision and reception

\- 用于提供与接收测试向量的信号源和信号汇

\- On-chip TAMs to connect the wrapper to the sources/sinks

\- 片上 TAM，用于把外壳与信号源/信号汇连接起来

In addition to the hardware components, the 1500 uses a test-specific language called Core Test Language (CTL) to communicate information between core providers and core users. This language is now considered part of the 1500 standard, and describing the 1500 wrapper as well as the test data for a reusable core is required.

除硬件部件外，1500 还使用一种专用于测试的语言——核测试语言（CTL，Core Test Language）——在核提供方与核用户之间传递信息。该语言现在被视为 1500 标准的一部分；对一个可复用的核而言，必须用它来描述 1500 外壳以及测试数据。

It should be noted that, similar to boundary scan, the 1500 standard itself only standardizes the core test mechanism for core access/isolation protocols and test mode control. The system-level test access mechanism still must be defined by the system integrator. Also, any test methods inside each core must be defined and implemented by the core providers.

应当指出，与边界扫描类似，1500 标准本身只针对核访问/隔离协议和测试模式控制对核测试机制加以标准化。系统级的测试访问机制仍必须由系统集成商来定义。此外，每个核内部的任何测试方法都必须由核提供方定义并实现。

#### 10.4.2 Overall Architecture

The most important feature of the 1500 standard is the provision of a wrapper on the boundary (I/O terminals) of each core, thereby allowing the test interface of the core to be standardized and the test commands to be executed. An overall architecture of IEEE 1500 is shown in Figure 10.21, where a system with N cores, each wrapped by an IEEE 1500 wrapper, is illustrated. The wrapper serial port (WSP) is a set of I/O terminals of the wrapper for serial operations. It consists of the wrapper serial input (WSI), the wrapper serial output (WSO), and several wrapper serial control (WSC) terminals. Each wrapper has a wrapper instruction register (WIR), which is used to store the instruction to be executed in the corresponding core. The WSP supports the serial test mode similar to that in a boundary-scan architecture, but without using a TAP controller (i.e., the serial control signals of 1500 are directly applied to the core without the conversion of the TAP controller). This is discussed further in Section 10.4.3.

1500 标准最重要的特性，是在每个核（core）的边界（I/O 端子）上设置一个外壳（wrapper），从而使核的测试接口得以标准化，测试命令得以执行。IEEE 1500 的总体架构如图 10.21 所示，图中给出了一个包含 N 个核的系统，每个核都由一个 IEEE 1500 外壳包裹。外壳串行端口（WSP）是外壳用于串行操作的一组 I/O 端子，由外壳串行输入（WSI）、外壳串行输出（WSO）和若干外壳串行控制（WSC，wrapper serial control）端子组成。每个外壳都有一个外壳指令寄存器（WIR，wrapper instruction register），用于存储将在对应核中执行的指令。WSP 支持与边界扫描架构类似的串行测试模式，但不需要使用 TAP 控制器（也就是说，1500 的串行控制信号直接施加到核上，而无需经过 TAP 控制器的转换）。这一点将在 10.4.3 节进一步讨论。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_456.jpg>)  
A system overview of the IEEE 1500 standard.

IEEE 1500 标准的系统概览。

In addition to the serial test mode, the 1500 standard also supports a paral lel test mode by incorporating a user-defined, parallel test access mechanism (TAM). Each core can have its own TAM-in and TAM-out ports consisting of a number of data or control lines for parallel test operations. The user-defined, par allel TAM can transport test signals from the TAM-source to the cores through TAM-in and from the cores to the TAM-sink through TAM-out. In Figure 10.22 the interface of a core is highlighted and both parallel and serial data/control signals are indicated; the wrapper parallel control (WPC) and wrapper parallel input (WPI) signals correspond to the TAM-in port, and the wrapper parallel out put (WPO) signals correspond to the TAM-out port in Figure 10.21. It should be pointed out that for the 1500 standard the serial ports are mandatory while the parallel ports are optional; however, the parallel interface represents one main dif ference between 1500 and 1149.1 that leads to a significant time reduction for SOC testing.

除串行测试模式外，1500 标准还通过引入用户定义的并行测试访问机制（TAM，test access mechanism）来支持并行测试模式。每个核都可以拥有自己的 TAM-in 和 TAM-out 端口，它们由若干用于并行测试操作的数据线或控制线构成。用户定义的并行 TAM 可以将测试信号经 TAM-in 从 TAM 源（TAM-source）传送到各核，并经 TAM-out 将信号从各核传送到 TAM 汇（TAM-sink）。图 10.22 突出显示了一个核的接口，并同时标出并行与串行的数据/控制信号；外壳并行控制（WPC）和外壳并行输入（WPI）信号对应图 10.21 中的 TAM-in 端口，外壳并行输出（WPO）信号对应图 10.21 中的 TAM-out 端口。需要指出的是，在 1500 标准中，串行端口是强制性的，而并行端口是可选的；然而，并行接口正是 1500 与 1149.1 之间的一个主要区别，它使片上系统（SOC）测试时间显著缩短。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_457.jpg>)  
Test interface of a core wrapper.

核外壳的测试接口。

#### 10.4.3 Wrapper Components and Functions

Figure 10.23 shows the detailed hardware structure of the IEEE 1500 standard core wrapper, which is comprised of five components, as described below.

图 10.23 展示了 IEEE 1500 标准核外壳的详细硬件结构，它由五个部件组成，如下所述。

1. A wrapper serial port (WSP), which consists of a wrapper serial input (WSI), a wrapper serial output (WSO), and several wrapper serial control (WSC) terminals. Similar to the TDI and TDO of 1149.1, the WSI and WSO terminals are used to scan in and scan out wrapper test instructions and data. Both WSI and WSO are mandatory for 1500. The WSC contains six mandatory control terminals (WRSTN, WRCK, SelectWIR, CaptureWR, ShiftWR, and UpdateWR), one optional control terminal (TransferDR), and some optional clock terminals (AUXCKn). These terminals are described next. Some operations enabled by these terminals will be described later.

1. 外壳串行端口（WSP），由外壳串行输入（WSI）、外壳串行输出（WSO）和若干外壳串行控制（WSC）端子组成。与 1149.1 中的 TDI 和 TDO 类似，WSI 和 WSO 端子用于扫描输入和扫描输出外壳测试指令与数据。对 1500 而言，WSI 和 WSO 都是强制性的。WSC 包含六个强制性控制端子（WRSTN、WRCK、SelectWIR、CaptureWR、ShiftWR 和 UpdateWR）、一个可选控制端子（TransferDR）以及一些可选时钟端子（AUXCKn）。这些端子将在下文描述，由这些端子使能的一些操作将在后面说明。

\- WRCK—This mandatory wrapper clock terminal is dedicated to the operation of the 1500 standard functions.
\- WRCK——该强制性的外壳时钟端子专用于 1500 标准功能的运行。

AUXCKn—These optional auxiliary 1500 clocks can be used for some implementations of wrapper boundary registers. The “n” indicates the number of these auxiliary clocks that shall be indexed by 1	 2	    	 n. These clocks may be shared with the system clocks. When they are employed, the user must clearly define the timing relation between these signals and WRCK.
AUXCKn——这些可选的 1500 辅助时钟（auxiliary clock）可用于外壳边界寄存器（WBR，wrapper boundary register）的某些实现。其中“n”表示这些辅助时钟的数量，应按 1 到 n 编号。这些时钟可以与系统时钟共享。当使用它们时，用户必须明确定义这些信号与 WRCK 之间的时序关系。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_458.jpg>)

- FIGURE 10.23

Serial test circuitry of the 1500 standard for a core.

用于核的 1500 标准串行测试电路。

WRSTN—This mandatory wrapper reset terminal resets the wrapper cir cuitry and puts the wrapper into the normal system mode when asserted. The wrapper bypass instruction, which is similar to the bypass instruc tion in 1149.1, shall be automatically loaded into the wrapper instruction register whenever WRSTN is asserted.
WRSTN——该强制性的外壳复位端子在有效时复位外壳电路，并将外壳置于正常系统模式。每当 WRSTN 有效时，外壳旁路指令（类似于 1149.1 中的旁路指令）都会被自动加载到外壳指令寄存器中。

\- SelectWIR—This mandatory terminal is used to determine whether an instruction or data type of operation is to be performed. When SelectWIR 1, WIR is selected and connected between WSI and WSO; otherwise, some data register(s) is connected between WSI and WSO.
\- SelectWIR——该强制性端子用于确定将执行指令类操作还是数据类操作。当 SelectWIR 为 1 时，选中 WIR 并将其连接在 WSI 与 WSO 之间；否则，将某个（些）数据寄存器连接在 WSI 与 WSO 之间。

\- CaptureWR—This mandatory terminal is used to enable the capture oper ation for the selected register(s).
\- CaptureWR——该强制性端子用于使能所选寄存器的捕获（Capture）操作。

\- ShiftWR—This mandatory terminal is used to enable the Shift operation for the selected register(s).
\- ShiftWR——该强制性端子用于使能所选寄存器的移位（Shift）操作。

\- UpdateWR—This mandatory terminal is used to enable the Update operation for the selected register(s).
\- UpdateWR——该强制性端子用于使能所选寄存器的更新（Update）操作。

\- TransferDR—This optional terminal enables the Transfer operation for selected register(s) that implement the Transfer function.
\- TransferDR——该可选端子对实现了传送（Transfer）功能的所选寄存器使能传送操作。

Similar to 1149.1, correct timing is also critical for proper operation of the 1500 circuitry. In the 1500 standard, it is required that the SelectWIR, ShiftWR, CaptureWR, and TransferDR be sampled at the rising edge of WRCK and the UpdateWR be sampled at the falling edge of the WRCK.

与 1149.1 类似，正确的时序对 1500 电路的正常工作同样至关重要。1500 标准要求 SelectWIR、ShiftWR、CaptureWR 和 TransferDR 在 WRCK 的上升沿被采样，而 UpdateWR 在 WRCK 的下降沿被采样。

2. A wrapper parallel port (WPP), which consists of user-defined wrapper parallel input (WPI) terminals, wrapper parallel output (WPO) terminals, and wrapper parallel control (WPC) terminals. All of these terminals are optional. A WPP may include the clock terminals of WSC (the WRCK and AUXCK terminals) but may not replace other WSC terminals.
2. 外壳并行端口（WPP），由用户定义的外壳并行输入（WPI）端子、外壳并行输出（WPO）端子和外壳并行控制（WPC）端子组成。所有这些端子都是可选的。WPP 可以包含 WSC 的时钟端子（WRCK 和 AUXCK 端子），但不能取代 WSC 的其他端子。

3. A wrapper instruction register (WIR), which is used to store the instruction to be executed, similar to the instruction register in 1149.1. The WIR is unconditionally selected whenever the SelectWIR of WSC is set to 1, regardless of the current wrapper instruction and selected wrapper/core data registers. It is implemented using a two-stage design such that the shifting of a new instruction will not interfere with the current instruction. The two main differences between the instruction registers of 1149.1 and 1500 are described below.
3. 外壳指令寄存器（WIR），用于存储待执行的指令，类似于 1149.1 中的指令寄存器。只要 WSC 中的 SelectWIR 被置为 1，WIR 就会被无条件选中，而与当前的外壳指令以及所选的外壳/核数据寄存器无关。WIR 采用两级设计实现，使得移入新指令不会干扰当前指令。1149.1 与 1500 的指令寄存器之间的两个主要区别描述如下。

First, because there is no finite-state machine in 1500, the control signals provided by the WIR are derived from both the current wrapper instruction and the current states of the signals connected to the WSC terminals. Figure 10.24 shows the circuitry design of a WIR. It consists of a shift stage and a decode/update stage. Three sets of essential control signals (DR\_Select, WBY\_Cntrl, and WBR\_Cntrl) are used to select the appropriate register(s), control the operations of the wrapper bypass register, and control the operation of the wrapper boundary register, respectively. Other control signals, such as those for other wrapper data registers (WDR), those for core data registers (CDR), and those for the core itself, can also be generated. Note that these control signals are defined in a quite flexible way and the user may use different names for these signals.

第一，由于 1500 中没有有限状态机，WIR 提供的控制信号由当前外壳指令和连接到 WSC 端子的信号的当前状态共同导出。图 10.24 展示了 WIR 的电路设计，它由移位级和译码/更新级组成。三组必要的控制信号（DR\_Select、WBY\_Cntrl 和 WBR\_Cntrl）分别用于选择合适的寄存器、控制外壳旁路寄存器的操作以及控制外壳边界寄存器的操作。此外还可以生成其他控制信号，例如用于其他外壳数据寄存器（WDR，wrapper data register）的信号、用于核数据寄存器（CDR）的信号以及用于核本身的信号。注意，这些控制信号的定义方式相当灵活，用户可以为这些信号使用不同的名称。

The second difference is that, in addition to the serial shift-in operation of a new instruction through the WSI–WSO chain, the 1500 standard optionally provides a parallel load mode, as shown in Figure 10.24. This permits the WIR to capture test control information directly (remember that the WSC terminals are also inputs to WIR) or to capture data that can be used to test the WIR or other 1500 circuitry.

第二个区别是，除了通过 WSI–WSO 链串行移入新指令之外，1500 标准还可选地提供并行加载模式，如图 10.24 所示。这使得 WIR 能够直接捕获测试控制信息（记住 WSC 端子也是 WIR 的输入），或者捕获可用于测试 WIR 或其他 1500 电路的数据。

4. A wrapper bypass register (WBY), which bypasses test signals similar to the bypass register in 1149.1. The WBY should be selected and connected between WSI and WSO when WRSTN is asserted or when the current instruction is the
4. 外壳旁路寄存器（WBY，wrapper bypass register），用于旁路测试信号，类似于 1149.1 中的旁路寄存器。当 WRSTN 有效或当前指令为外壳旁路指令时，应选中 WBY 并将其连接在 WSI 与 WSO 之间。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_459.jpg>)

- FIGURE 10.24

WIR circuitry design.

WIR 电路设计。

wrapper bypass instruction. It is also the default register to be put between WSI and WSO when no other wrapper data register is selected or when an unused wrapper instruction opcode appears in the WIR.

当没有选择其他外壳数据寄存器、或 WIR 中出现未使用的外壳指令操作码时，WBY 也是放入 WSI 与 WSO 之间的默认寄存器。

5. A wrapper boundary register (WBR), which consists of wrapper bound ary cells (WBCs) similar to the boundary-scan register in 1149.1. Each WBC has four data terminals: cell functional input (CFI), cell functional out put (CFO), cell test input (CTI), and cell test output (CTO), as shown in Figure 10.23. The functional modes and operation events of WBR are described next.
5. 外壳边界寄存器（WBR，wrapper boundary register），由外壳边界单元（WBC，wrapper boundary cell）组成，类似于 1149.1 中的边界扫描寄存器。如图 10.23 所示，每个 WBC 有四个数据端子：单元功能输入（CFI）、单元功能输出（CFO）、单元测试输入（CTI）和单元测试输出（CTO）。WBR 的功能模式与操作事件将在下文描述。

Functional modes of WBR—Four modes are defined as follows:

WBR 的功能模式——定义了如下四种模式：

\- Normal mode—The WBR is transparent to the system and the core executes its normal functions.
\- 正常模式（Normal mode）——WBR 对系统透明，核执行其正常功能。

\- Inward facing mode—The test access is for the core itself; that is, the functional inputs of the core are controlled and the functional outputs of the core are observed by the WBR (see Figure 10.23).
\- 内向模式（Inward facing mode）——测试访问面向核自身，即由 WBR 控制核的功能输入并观测核的功能输出（见图 10.23）。

Outward facing mode—The test access is for external circuitry; that is, the wrapper functional outputs and the wrapper parallel outputs (of WPP) are controlled by the WBR, and the wrapper functional inputs and wrapper parallel inputs are observed (or captured) by the WBR (see Figure 10.23).
外向模式（Outward facing mode）——测试访问面向外部电路，即由 WBR 控制外壳功能输出和（WPP 的）外壳并行输出，并观测（或捕获）外壳功能输入和外壳并行输入（见图 10.23）。

\- Nonhazardous (safe) mode—The functional inputs of the core and wrapper functional outputs are controlled by WBR to a safe state.
\- 无害（安全）模式（Nonhazardous (safe) mode）——核的功能输入和外壳功能输出被 WBR 控制到安全状态。

Operation events of WBR and WBC—Five events (Shift, Capture, Update, Transfer, and Apply) are supported by the WBR (or WBC) in 1500. We will use “bubble” diagrams to help illustrate these events. The four symbols shown in Figure 10.25 are used to represent the structures of all WBCs, where a circle represents a storage element, an arrow represents a data path, a vertical line together with two or more input arrows and one output arrow represents a decision point, and two arrows emerging from a single point represent two data paths from the same signal source. Each circle may be characterized by one or more characters from the set of S, C, U, T, and F to indicate that the corresponding storage element is responsible for the Shift, Capture, Update, Transfer, and any Functional event, respectively.

WBR 与 WBC 的操作事件——1500 中的 WBR（或 WBC）支持五种事件：移位（Shift）、捕获（Capture）、更新（Update）、传送（Transfer）和施加（Apply）。我们将借助“气泡图”（bubble diagram）来帮助说明这些事件。图 10.25 中所示的四个符号用于表示所有 WBC 的结构：圆圈表示存储元件，箭头表示数据通路，一条竖线连同两条或多条输入箭头和一条输出箭头表示一个判决点，从同一点引出的两条箭头表示来自同一信号源的两条数据通路。每个圆圈可以用集合 S、C、U、T、F 中的一个或多个字符来标注，表示相应的存储元件分别负责移位、捕获、更新、传送以及任意功能（Functional）事件。

Several bubble diagrams representing different types of WBCs provided in the IEEE 1500-2005 standard document are provided in Figure 10.26, where their names are shown under each WBC. The events supported by each WBC are indicated by the characters in the storage elements; for example, Figure 10.26a shows a simple WBC that contains only one storage element and supports only the Shift and Capture events, while Figure 10.26e shows a WBC that contains three storage elements, two of which are used for the Shift and Transfer events and the third one for the Update, Capture, and Functional events. Note that Figure 10.26d corresponds to a boundary-scan cell shown in Figure 10.6. Also note that Figure 10.26g does not support the Capture event. This may represent a WBC for a core terminal that can be exempted from being wrapped, such as a clock or a reset terminal of the core. These five events are described below:

IEEE 1500-2005 标准文档中给出的几种不同类型 WBC 的气泡图如图 10.26 所示，各 WBC 的名称标注在其下方。每个 WBC 所支持的事件由其存储元件中的字符指示；例如，图 10.26a 给出了一个只包含一个存储元件、且仅支持移位和捕获事件的简单 WBC，而图 10.26e 给出的 WBC 包含三个存储元件，其中两个用于移位和传送事件，第三个用于更新、捕获和功能事件。注意，图 10.26d 对应于图 10.6 所示的边界扫描单元。另需注意，图 10.26g 不支持捕获事件，这可以表示用于可免于包裹的核端子（例如核的时钟或复位端子）的 WBC。下面对这五种事件逐一描述：

\- Shift event—A mandatory event whereby the data stored in the WBR shift path are advanced one storage position closer to the WBR’s serial test output. The data present at the WBR’s serial test input are loaded into the shift path storage element closest to the WBR’s input.
\- 移位事件（Shift event）——一种强制性事件：WBR 移位路径中所存储的数据向 WBR 串行测试输出方向前移一个存储位置；WBR 串行测试输入上出现的数据被加载到最靠近 WBR 输入的移位路径存储元件中。

Capture event—An event whereby the data present on the CFI or CFO of a WBC are captured and stored in a storage element within the WBC; for example, Figures 10.26a shows a WBC that captures data from CFI, while Figure 10.26h shows a WBC that can capture data from both the CFI and CFO. Unless the WBC is used for a terminal that can be exempted from being wrapped such as a clock or reset terminal, this event is mandatory for all WBCs.
捕获事件（Capture event）——一种事件：将 WBC 的 CFI 或 CFO 上出现的数据捕获并存储到 WBC 内的存储元件中；例如，图 10.26a 给出的 WBC 从 CFI 捕获数据，而图 10.26h 给出的 WBC 可以同时从 CFI 和 CFO 捕获数据。除非该 WBC 用于可免于包裹的端子（如时钟或复位端子），否则该事件对所有 WBC 都是强制性的。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_460.jpg>)

- FIGURE 10.25

The four symbols used in bubble diagrams.

气泡图中使用的四个符号。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_461.jpg>)

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_462.jpg>)

- FIGURE 10.26

Update event—An optional event whereby data stored in a WBC’s shift path storage element closest to CTO are loaded into an off-shift-path storage element of the WBC. Note that this event is optional in 1500; for example, the WBCs in parts a, b, c, and g of Figure 10.26 do not support this event.
更新事件（Update event）——一种可选事件：将 WBC 移位路径中最靠近 CTO 的存储元件所存储的数据，加载到 WBC 中移位路径之外的存储元件。注意，该事件在 1500 中是可选的；例如，图 10.26 的 a、b、c、g 部分中的 WBC 都不支持该事件。

Transfer event—An optional event that either moves data to the storage element closest to the CTI of a WBC, if the data stored by the Capture event are not on this storage element (Figure 10.26b,e), or moves the data one storage position closer to the CTO (Figure 10.26c,e,f). There are two purposes for the Transfer event. First, in order to preserve as many capture values as there are storage elements in the shift path, captured data should enter a WBC’s shift path via the storage element closest to CTI. Second, to provide sequential stimuli data such as those required for delay testing, Transfer moves data through the shift path so that each bit may be sequentially loaded into the update storage element and then applied to the CFO of the WBC.
传送事件（Transfer event）——一种可选事件：如果捕获事件所存储的数据不在最靠近 CTI 的存储元件上，则将数据移动到 WBC 中最靠近 CTI 的存储元件（图 10.26b、e）；否则将数据向 CTO 方向前移一个存储位置（图 10.26c、e、f）。传送事件有两个目的：其一，为了使保留下来的捕获值数目与移位路径中存储元件的数目一样多，被捕获的数据应经由最靠近 CTI 的存储元件进入 WBC 的移位路径；其二，为了提供时序激励数据（例如延迟测试所需的数据），传送事件使数据沿移位路径移动，从而每一位可以被依次加载到更新存储元件中，然后施加到 WBC 的 CFO 上。

Apply event—A derivative event inferred from the operation of the other four events (Shift, Update, Transfer, and Capture) whereby test data become active and effective as test stimuli. While the wrapper is in inward (outward) facing mode, the Apply event causes test data to be applied from input (output) cells onto the functional inputs of the core (WBR’s functional outputs). The test data are the data stored in the shift path storage element closest to CTO unless the Update event is supported, in which case the test data shall be the data stored in the off-shift-path storage element by the Update event. It should be noted that the Apply event is a virtual event inferred from other events and hence is not specifically represented in the bubble diagrams shown in Figure 10.26.
施加事件（Apply event）——由其他四种事件（移位、更新、传送和捕获）的操作推导出来的一种派生事件，此时测试数据变为有效并作为测试激励生效。当外壳处于内向（外向）模式时，施加事件使测试数据从输入（输出）单元施加到核的功能输入（WBR 的功能输出）上。测试数据是存储在最靠近 CTO 的移位路径存储元件中的数据；如果支持更新事件，则测试数据应为更新事件存储在移位路径之外存储元件中的数据。需要注意，施加事件是由其他事件推导出的虚拟事件，因此没有在图 10.26 所示的气泡图中专门表示。

In the following we give two examples to illustrate how the signals generated by the WIR control the operations of the WBR and WBCs.

下面我们给出两个例子，说明 WIR 产生的信号如何控制 WBR 和 WBC 的操作。

Example 10.1

例 10.1

In Figure 10.27, we provide an example of a WIR interface to the WBY, WBR, WDRs, and CDRs of a core. The WSO of the core is connected to the serial output of WIR (i.e., WIR\_WSO) or the serial output of one of the data registers—WBY, WBR, CDRs, or other WDRs (i.e., DR\_WSO) under the direct control of the SelectWIR signal. The serial output (DR\_WSO) of the data registers is in turn controlled by the Dr\_Selectn    0 generated by the WIR. All other signals are applied to the data registers as described in the next example.
图 10.27 给出了一个 WIR 与某个核的 WBY、WBR、WDR 及 CDR 相接口的例子。在 SelectWIR 信号的直接控制下，核的 WSO 连接到 WIR 的串行输出（即 WIR\_WSO）或某个数据寄存器——WBY、WBR、CDR 或其他 WDR——的串行输出（即 DR\_WSO）。数据寄存器的串行输出（DR\_WSO）又受 WIR 产生的 Dr\_Selectn 控制。所有其他信号则按照下一个例子所述的方式施加到数据寄存器上。

In this design, the Mode signal is generated by the WIR and is used to determine whether the cell is in the normal or test mode operation. The IO\_FACE signal, also generated by the WIR, is used

to determine whether the core is in the inward or outward facing configuration. Both of these two signals are WBR\_Cntrl signals, as they are generated for the WBCs. The SHIFT, CAPTURE, and XFER signals, which are derived directly from the ShiftWR, CaptureWR, and TransferDR signals, determine which event is being executed. D1 and D2 flip-flops correspond to the storage elements closest to CTI and CTO, respectively, as shown in Figure 10.26b. As D1 supports two events (S and T in the bubble diagram), its input comes from three sources. When SHIFT is asserted, it receives data from CTI; when XFER is asserted, it receives data from the output of D2; and when neither of these two signals is asserted, it holds its current state. The D2 flip-flop supports three events (S, C, and T). It participates in the Shift event whenever SHIFT is asserted; it captures the data at CFO when CAPT is asserted and IO\_FACT 0 (the instruction is an inward facing one); and it receives data from the D1 flip-flop when XFER is asserted and IO\_FACT 1. When neither of these events is executed, it holds its state.

确定核处于内向还是外向配置。这两个信号都是 WBR\_Cntrl 信号，因为它们是为 WBC 产生的。SHIFT、CAPTURE 和 XFER 信号直接由 ShiftWR、CaptureWR 和 TransferDR 信号导出，用于确定正在执行哪个事件。如图 10.26b 所示，D1 和 D2 触发器分别对应最靠近 CTI 和 CTO 的存储元件。由于 D1 支持两个事件（气泡图中的 S 和 T），其输入来自三个来源：当 SHIFT 有效时，它接收来自 CTI 的数据；当 XFER 有效时，它接收来自 D2 输出的数据；当这两个信号都无效时，它保持当前状态。D2 触发器支持三个事件（S、C 和 T）：只要 SHIFT 有效，它就参与移位事件；当 CAPT 有效且 IO\_FACE 为 0（即该指令是内向型指令）时，它捕获 CFO 上的数据；当 XFER 有效且 IO\_FACE 为 1 时，它接收来自 D1 触发器的数据。当这些事件都未执行时，它保持其状态。

#### 10.4.4 Instruction Set

The IEEE 1500 standard has a richer instruction set than 1149.1, as many instructions have additional parallel options. In this section, all instructions defined in 1500-2005 are described. These instructions follow the following naming convention:

IEEE 1500 标准拥有比 1149.1 更丰富的指令集，因为许多指令带有额外的并行选项。本节描述 1500-2005 中定义的所有指令。这些指令遵循以下命名约定：

W<S/P/H>\_<Command>{\_<Configuration>}—(e.g., WS\_INTEST\_RING), where the first “W” is the preface for all 1500 instructions. S, P, and H represent the serial, parallel, and hybrid test modes, respectively. A serial instruction uses WSI, WSO, and WSC only. A parallel instruction mainly uses WPI, WPO, and WPC and must have only the WBY between WSI and WSO. A hybrid instruction involves the use of both serial and parallel ports. An instruction simultaneously using parallel ports and configuring registers other than WBY between WSI and WSO is considered to be a hybrid one. In the following description, an “x” may be used for some instructions. In these cases, the “x” should be replaced by S, P, or H. Command represents the operation of the instruction (e.g., EXTEST or BYPASS). Configuration describes the test configuration selected by the instruction. In 1500-2005, this field only appears in the WS\_INTEST\_SCAN and WS\_INTEST\_RING instructions where the “SCAN” in WS\_INTEST\_SCAN indicates that the internal scan chain is included in the WSI–WSO chain in addition to the WBR, while the “RING” in WS\_INTEST\_RING indicates that only the WBR is between WSI and WSO. Next, we describe these instructions in more detail with the help of Figure 10.29.

W<S/P/H>\_<Command>{\_<Configuration>}——（例如 WS\_INTEST\_RING），其中开头的“W”是所有 1500 指令的前缀。S、P、H 分别表示串行、并行和混合（hybrid）测试模式。串行指令只使用 WSI、WSO 和 WSC。并行指令主要使用 WPI、WPO 和 WPC，且 WSI 与 WSO 之间必须只有 WBY。混合指令则同时涉及串行和并行端口的使用。同时使用并行端口、且在 WSI 与 WSO 之间配置了 WBY 以外寄存器的指令被视为混合指令。在下面的描述中，某些指令会用到“x”，此时“x”应替换为 S、P 或 H。Command 表示指令的操作（如 EXTEST 或 BYPASS）。Configuration 描述该指令所选择的测试配置。在 1500-2005 中，该字段只出现在 WS\_INTEST\_SCAN 和 WS\_INTEST\_RING 两条指令中：WS\_INTEST\_SCAN 中的“SCAN”表示除 WBR 之外，内部扫描链也包含在 WSI–WSO 链中；而 WS\_INTEST\_RING 中的“RING”表示 WSI 与 WSO 之间只有 WBR。接下来，我们借助图 10.29 更详细地描述这些指令。

\- WS\_BYPASS: (Figure 10.29a)—This mandatory instruction is used to bypass the test information and enables the normal functional configuration of the wrapper. The WSI–WSO connection only passes through the WBY to allow rapid data movement.
\- WS\_BYPASS：（图 10.29a）——该强制性指令用于旁路测试信息，并使外壳处于正常功能配置。WSI–WSO 连接仅经过 WBY，以便快速传送数据。

WS\_EXTEST (Figure 10.29b)—This mandatory instruction allows testing of core-to-core interconnects and the off-chip user-defined logic (UDL) using a single scan chain configuration. Only the WBR is connected for serial access between WSI and WSO during the Shift operation. The test data can be loaded into the WBR using a Wx\_PREOLOAD instruction prior to the WS\_EXTEST instruction. The WBR shall be operated in the output facing mode, meaning that the values present at the CFOs of the WBCs can be applied to the external UDL or interconnects and the test results from these external circuits can be captured to the WBR through the CFIs of the WBCs. The execution of this instruction is similar to that of the EXTEST instruction of 1149.1.

WS\_EXTEST（图 10.29b）——该强制性指令使用单扫描链配置来测试核间互连和片外用户定义逻辑（UDL，user-defined logic）。在移位操作期间，WSI 与 WSO 之间仅连接 WBR 进行串行访问。可以在 WS\_EXTEST 指令之前，先使用 Wx\_PREOLOAD 指令将测试数据加载到 WBR 中。WBR 应工作在外向（output facing）模式，也就是说，WBC 的 CFO 上出现的值可以施加到外部 UDL 或互连上，而这些外部电路的测试结果可以通过 WBC 的 CFI 捕获到 WBR 中。该指令的执行类似于 1149.1 的 EXTEST 指令。

WP\_EXTEST (Figure 10.29c)—This optional instruction allows testing of core-to-core interconnects and the off-chip UDL using a multiple scan chain configuration. The WBR can be divided into multiple segments (multiple scan chains) and the test data can be loaded into WBR using multiple WPI–WBR– WPO paths under the control of a user-defined WPC. Other than the parallel data transmission, this instruction mimics the WS\_EXTEST instruction.

WP\_EXTEST（图 10.29c）——该可选指令使用多扫描链配置来测试核间互连和片外 UDL。WBR 可以划分为多个段（多条扫描链），在用户定义的 WPC 控制下，测试数据可以通过多条 WPI–WBR–WPO 路径加载到 WBR 中。除并行数据传输外，该指令与 WS\_EXTEST 指令类似。

Wx\_EXTEST—When the “x” in this user-specified instruction is replaced by S (P), this instruction is the same as the WS\_EXTEST (WP\_EXTEST) instruction and follows all rules defined in the 1500 standard. When the “x” is replaced by H, the instruction becomes a hybrid one, which may allow more flexible capabilities to carry out the EXTEST operation using a mixed series and parallel configuration.

Wx\_EXTEST——当该用户自定义指令中的“x”替换为 S（P）时，该指令与 WS\_EXTEST（WP\_EXTEST）指令相同，并遵循 1500 标准定义的全部规则。当“x”替换为 H 时，该指令成为混合指令，可以更灵活地以串并混合配置执行 EXTEST 操作。

\- WS\_SAFE (Figure 10.29d)—This optional instruction provides a straight forward way for the core integrator to put a wrapper into a static and safe state. If this instruction is present, the wrapper functional outputs of the WBR shall be hardwired to constant values that have been predetermined when the cores are wrapped. Note that the safe state can also be achieved by using a preload instruction followed by a WS\_CLAMP instruction as described below.
\- WS\_SAFE（图 10.29d）——该可选指令为核集成者提供了一种将外壳置入静态安全状态的直接方式。如果存在该指令，WBR 的外壳功能输出应被硬连线到包裹核时预先确定的常数值。注意，也可以按照下文所述，先使用预加载（preload）指令、再使用 WS\_CLAMP 指令来达到安全状态。

WS\_PRELOAD (Figure 10.29e)—This conditionally required instruction allows test data to be serially loaded into the WBR without interfering with the operation of cores or UDL attached to the WBR. It is mandatory when the WBR is composed entirely of cells with a shift path supporting the Shift opera tion that keeps the WFO terminals static. Similar to the PRELOAD instruction in 1149.1, this instruction can be used to load test data for external testing prior to the WS\_EXTEST instruction to prevent possible indeterminate states at the wrapper functional outputs when loading the WS\_EXTEST instruction (see Section 10.2.6).

WS\_PRELOAD（图 10.29e）——该条件必需指令允许在不干扰核或连接到 WBR 的 UDL 操作的情况下，将测试数据串行加载到 WBR 中。当 WBR 完全由这样的单元组成——其移位路径支持移位操作并保持 WFO 端子静止——时，该指令是强制性的。与 1149.1 中的 PRELOAD 指令类似，该指令可在 WS\_EXTEST 指令之前用于加载外部测试所需的测试数据，以防止在加载 WS\_EXTEST 指令时外壳功能输出出现可能的不定态（见 10.2.6 节）。

WP\_PRELOAD (Figure 10.29f)—This optional instruction allows the WBR to be divided into multiple segments, and all segments can be loaded with test data simultaneously. This instruction is typically utilized before some defined instructions such as WP\_EXTEST. It is usually preferred over the WS\_PRELOAD due to better data transfer efficiency. One can expect that with the WP\_PRELOAD and WP\_EXTEST instructions, plus the parallel loading capability of the WIR, interconnect and UDL testing can be carried out quite efficiently.

WP\_PRELOAD（图 10.29f）——该可选指令允许将 WBR 划分为多个段，并且所有段可以同时加载测试数据。该指令通常在某些已定义的指令（如 WP\_EXTEST）之前使用。由于数据传输效率更高，它通常比 WS\_PRELOAD 更受青睐。可以预期，借助 WP\_PRELOAD 和 WP\_EXTEST 指令，再加上 WIR 的并行加载能力，互连测试和 UDL 测试可以相当高效地进行。

WS\_CLAMP (Figure 10.29g)—This optional instruction allows the state of signals driven by the wrapper functional outputs to be determined by the data prestored in the WBR. The test control for this instruction shall be provided by the WSC, and the WBY shall be connected for serial access between WSI and WSO. The core with this instruction shall be put into a quiet mode (e.g., reset or clock off). It is the responsibility of the user of this instruction to make sure the wrapper functional outputs of the WBR are in the desired state (e.g., via Wx\_PRELOAD) when this instruction is used.

WS\_CLAMP（图 10.29g）——该可选指令使外壳功能输出所驱动的信号状态由预存储在 WBR 中的数据决定。该指令的测试控制应由 WSC 提供，并且 WBY 应连接在 WSI 与 WSO 之间进行串行访问。使用该指令的核应被置于静默模式（例如复位或时钟关闭）。使用该指令时，用户有责任确保 WBR 的外壳功能输出处于期望状态（例如通过 Wx\_PRELOAD 实现）。

WS\_INTEST\_RING (Figure 10.29h)—This optional instruction allows single step testing of the core circuitry with each test pattern and response being shifted through the WBR, where the single-step testing of the core means that the core will move one step forward in its operation each time shifting of the WBR is completed and applied. One such example is the single-step testing for a CPU. The WBR shall be the only register connected between WSI and WSO and shall be in the inward facing mode during this instruction. The test pattern can be applied to the core and the response can be captured by the WBR by enabling the Apply and the Capture events, respectively.

WS\_INTEST\_RING（图 10.29h）——该可选指令允许对核电路进行单步测试，每条测试图案及其响应都经由 WBR 移位；其中核的单步测试是指，每当 WBR 的一次移位完成并施加后，核的操作就前进一步。对 CPU 的单步测试就是这样一个例子。在该指令期间，WBR 应是连接在 WSI 与 WSO 之间的唯一寄存器，并应处于内向模式。通过分别使能施加（Apply）事件和捕获（Capture）事件，可以将测试图案施加到核上，并由 WBR 捕获响应。

\- WS\_INTEST\_SCAN (Figure 10.29i)—This instruction is the same as the WS\_INTEST\_RING instruction except that an internal scan chain of the core can be concatenated with the WBR to form a single scan chain. This allows more inside access to the core and can potentially provide better fault coverage than the WS\_INTEST\_RING instruction.
\- WS\_INTEST\_SCAN（图 10.29i）——该指令与 WS\_INTEST\_RING 指令相同，区别在于核的一条内部扫描链可以与 WBR 串接成一条扫描链。这允许对核内部进行更深入的访问，并可能提供比 WS\_INTEST\_RING 指令更好的故障覆盖率。

```txt
STIL 1.0 {
}
Signals { // defines each of the signal names of the core
}
Patterns { // contains the parallel and scan data for testing the core
}
Timing { // defines the waveform and corresponding timing on each
    // signal for each parallel or scan pattern
}
MacroDefs { // contains the protocol for applying test data to the core or
    // chip
}
```

Wx\_INTEST—For 1500, at least one INTEST instruction is required. This can be a WS\_INTEST\_RING, a WS\_INTEST\_SCAN, or a user-defined instruction with the name of Wx\_TEST, where “x” can also be S, P, and H. Note that in the 1500-2005 standard, parallel INTEST instructions are not defined; however, similar to the WP\_EXTEST instruction, a WP\_INTEST instruction would be highly beneficial in reducing test time if a large number of test access lines are available for the WPP.

Wx\_INTEST——对 1500 而言，至少需要一条 INTEST 指令。它可以是 WS\_INTEST\_RING、WS\_INTEST\_SCAN，或者是名称为 Wx\_TEST 的用户自定义指令，其中“x”同样可以取 S、P 和 H。注意，1500-2005 标准并未定义并行 INTEST 指令；然而，与 WP\_EXTEST 指令类似，如果有大量测试访问线可供 WPP 使用，WP\_INTEST 指令将非常有利于缩短测试时间。

#### 10.4.5 Core Test Language (CTL)

The core test language (CTL) is a language for capturing and expressing test-related information for reusable cores. It standardizes the description of all the information that the core providers must give to system integrators or design automation tools so a complete test for the embedded cores, interconnects among cores, and any user-defined logic around the cores can be created. CTL is an extension of the IEEE 1450 Standard Test Interface Language (STIL) standard [IEEE 1450- 1999] and is now defined in the IEEE draft standard P1450.6 (where “P” indicates proposed). While STIL is a language mainly for representing IC test patterns and waveforms, CTL provides additional information for core-specific controls to configure a core and its surrounding logic, as well as the requirements and constraints on the implementation of chip-level test interfaces for the core. Within CTL, one can create enough information at the boundary of the core to allow for successful (1) instantiation of a wrapper, (2) mapping of the core terminals to wrapper terminals, (3) reuse of the core test data, and (4) testing of the user-defined logic and wiring external to the core.

核测试语言（CTL，Core Test Language）是一种用于捕获和表达可复用核相关测试信息的语言。它对核提供者必须提供给系统集成者或设计自动化工具的全部信息的描述方式进行了标准化，从而可以为嵌入式核、核间互连以及核周围的用户定义逻辑创建完整的测试。CTL 是 IEEE 1450 标准测试接口语言（STIL，Standard Test Interface Language）标准 [IEEE 1450-1999] 的扩展，目前定义于 IEEE 标准草案 P1450.6（其中“P”表示 proposed，即提案）。STIL 是一种主要用于表示 IC 测试图案和波形的语言，而 CTL 则针对核专用控制提供附加信息，用于配置核及其周边逻辑，以及针对该核的芯片级测试接口实现的需求与约束。借助 CTL，人们可以在核的边界创建足够的信息，从而成功实现：(1) 外壳的实例化；(2) 核端子到外壳端子的映射；(3) 核测试数据的复用；(4) 核外部用户定义逻辑和连线的测试。

In addition to the basic information described by standard 1450 constructs, such as Signals, Patterns, Macros, and Timing, the CTL description of a design can be constructed by an environment statement consisting of various blocks that describe global information or different operating modes of the design. Following is what a CTL description of a design having two operation modes would look like:

除了用标准 1450 结构（如 Signals、Patterns、Macros 和 Timing）描述的基本信息之外，设计的 CTL 描述还可以通过一个环境（environment）语句来构建，该语句由描述全局信息或设计不同操作模式的多个块组成。下面是一个具有两种操作模式的设计的 CTL 描述的大致样子：

```txt
Environment {
    CTL {
    // Common information of all CTL blocks within the Environment
    }
    CTL model {    // Information about mode 1
    }
    CTL mode2 {    // Information about mode 2
    }
}
```

The blocks before the Environment block are standard STIL descriptions of the core I/O signals, test patterns, timing, and protocol to apply the patterns. Note that the patterns and the protocol to apply the patterns are separated in CTL. The core integrator only has to modify the latter without requiring significant changes to the test patterns when integrating the core into a system. The Environment block in this example contains one unnamed and two named blocks. The unnamed block is used to describe global information that will be used by other blocks. Each named block describes a test mode by specifying static attributes on the boundary signals of the core and/or the sequence and pattern information for the test mode. These attributes and information are described in the following format:

Environment 块之前的各个块，是对核 I/O 信号、测试图案、时序以及施加图案的协议的标准 STIL 描述。注意，在 CTL 中，测试图案与施加图案的协议是分开的。这样，在把核集成到系统中时，核集成者只需修改后者，而无需对测试图案做重大改动。本例的 Environment 块包含一个未命名块和两个命名块。未命名块用于描述将被其他块使用的全局信息。每个命名块通过在核的边界信号上指定静态属性、和/或指定该测试模式的序列与图案信息来描述一种测试模式。这些属性和信息按以下格式描述：

```txt
CTL mode_name {
    TestMode test_mode_name;
    Internal {
    //Describe information about the core itself
    }
    PatternInformation {
    //Describe pattern information for the mode
    }
    External {
    //Describe the outside environment expected for test integration
    }
    ScanInternal chain_name {
    //Describe information of scan chain within the design
    }
    Relation {
    //Describe the relation between signals or/and signal groups
    }
    TestResourceConstraints {
    //Describe the constraints on the testability of the design
    }
    CoreInstance {
    //Describe the internal level of hierarchy of the design
    }
}
```

Each named block in the Environment block shall specify its test mode name with the TestMode parameter. The Internal, PatternInformation, and External blocks are three essential blocks to specify the test mode as described below:

Environment 块中的每个命名块都应通过 TestMode 参数指定其测试模式名称。Internal、PatternInformation 和 External 块是指定测试模式的三个基本块，描述如下：

Internal—This block is used to describe the internal characteristics of the core signals so the core integrator can determine the pertinent test information for each terminal of the core without having to access the detailed design information. Examples of these characteristics include wrapper type, signal names, time accuracy requirements, and electrical characteristics such as analog or digital.

Internal——该块用于描述核信号的内部特性，使核集成者无需访问详细设计信息即可确定核每个端子的相关测试信息。这些特性的例子包括外壳类型、信号名称、时间精度要求以及电气特性（如模拟或数字）。

PatternInformation—This block is used to specify the purpose of each of the test patterns provided and the test mode necessary for the execution of each pattern. The fault model used, the number of faults considered, and the fault coverage achieved can also be given in this block.

PatternInformation——该块用于说明所提供的每条测试图案的目的，以及执行每条图案所需的测试模式。所使用的故障模型、考虑的故障数量以及达到的故障覆盖率也可以在该块中给出。

External—This block describes the external characteristics that are expected from the perspective of the core boundary. Examples include connections to chip pins (input, output, or bidirectional), connections to another named core, connections to TAM, and connections to UDL.

External——该块从核边界的视角描述所期望的外部特性。例子包括与芯片引脚的连接（输入、输出或双向）、与另一个命名核的连接、与 TAM 的连接以及与 UDL 的连接。

Other information specified in the CTL blocks includes the following:

CTL 块中指定的其他信息包括：

\- Information about the scan chains inside the core, which is described within the ScanInternal block
\- 核内部扫描链的相关信息，在 ScanInternal 块中描述

\- Relations between signals and signal groups within the scope of the CTL, which are defined in the Relation block
\- CTL 范围内信号与信号组之间的关系，在 Relation 块中定义

\- Internal level of reference to a hierarchy design, which is provided in the CoreInstance block
\- 对层次化设计的内部层级的引用，在 CoreInstance 块中提供

\- Test resource constraints, such as maximum scan length, maximum run time, and maximum power consumption during testing, which are specified in the TestResourceConstraint block
\- 测试资源约束，例如最大扫描链长度、最长运行时间和测试期间的最大功耗，在 TestResourceConstraint 块中指定

The IEEE 1500-2005 standard requires that the CTL description must be used for any design with the 1500 wrappers. Several examples of CTL to describe the various testmodesusing1500 test instructions are provided in the standard document [IEEE 1500-2005]. It is recommended that the reader refer to [Marinissen 1999], [Kapur 2001], and [IEEE P1450.6-2001] for more comprehensive descriptions of CTL.

IEEE 1500-2005 标准要求，任何带有 1500 外壳的设计都必须使用 CTL 描述。标准文档 [IEEE 1500-2005] 中提供了若干使用 1500 测试指令描述各种测试模式的 CTL 示例。建议读者参阅 [Marinissen 1999]、[Kapur 2001] 和 [IEEE P1450.6-2001]，以获得对 CTL 更全面的描述。

#### 10.4.6 Core Test Supporting and System Test Configurations

As mentioned in Section 10.4.1, unlike the chip-to-board relation in 1149.1, where chips are tested before being mounted onto a board, it is the responsibility of the test integrator to test all cores in an SOC. Fortunately, the 1500 standard does provide an efficient solution for testing the cores by allowing parallel test access with the user-defined WPP. Thus, the development of core testing in 1500 is easier than in 1149.1. For example, one can use the WPP to support the testing of a core with multiple scan chains by directly connecting some WPI, WPO, and WPC to the scan inputs, scan outputs, and scan enables of the core, respectively. Similarly, one can also provide necessary interface signals directly to a core to carry out the BIST operation of the core. The main problem here for 1500 is how to transfer test data between system test sinks/sources and the wrappers (see Figure 10.21).

如 10.4.1 节所述，与 1149.1 中“芯片先经测试再装板”的芯片—电路板关系不同，测试 SOC 中的所有核是测试集成者（test integrator）的责任。所幸的是，1500 标准通过用户自定义的 WPP 提供并行测试访问，确实为核测试提供了一种高效的解决方案。因此，在 1500 中开发核测试比在 1149.1 中更容易。例如，可以将若干 WPI、WPO 和 WPC 分别直接连接到核的扫描输入、扫描输出和扫描使能上，从而利用 WPP 支持对拥有多条扫描链的核的测试。类似地，也可以向核直接提供必要的接口信号，以执行核的 BIST 操作。1500 在这里的主要问题是如何在系统测试汇/源与外壳之间传送测试数据（见图 10.21）。

Because the serial mode of 1500 resembles that of 1149.1, the test configurations described in Section 10.2.9 also apply to a 1500-based system; however, because parallel access is allowed, it is beneficial to make use of the WPP to execute the core testing more efficiently. Figure 10.30 shows a general test structure with both WSP and WPP indicated. Because the WSP is mandatory and user-defined tes instructions can be loaded into the WIR to configure the core into any desired test structure, it is advantageous for the user to use the WSI and WSC to enable the cores to be tested through an ENA (enable) signal for simple test control of the whole chip. This, of course, is not mandatory, and users may design their own test enable protocols.

由于 1500 的串行模式与 1149.1 的类似，10.2.9 节所描述的测试配置同样适用于基于 1500 的系统；不过，由于允许并行访问，利用 WPP 来更高效地执行核测试是有益的。图 10.30 给出了一种同时标出 WSP 和 WPP 的通用测试结构。由于 WSP 是强制性的，且用户自定义的测试指令可以加载到 WIR 中，把核配置成任何期望的测试结构，因此对用户而言，宜使用 WSI 和 WSC，通过一个使能（ENA，enable）信号来使各核进入被测状态，从而实现对整个芯片的简单测试控制。当然，这并非强制性要求，用户也可以设计自己的测试使能协议。

There are several user-defined parallel TAM configurations. Figure 10.31 shows four such configurations: multiplexed, daisy-chained, direct-access (or distributionbased), and locally controlled [Aerts 1998] [Waayers 2005]. In the multiplexed archi tecture, only one core can get access to the available SOC TAM wires at a time, hence interconnect testing between cores is not easy to achieve. In the daisy-chain architecture, all cores can access all TAM wires during a test session and each core can be tested sequentially; however, if only a subset of cores is to be accessed simultaneously, a mechanism to bypass parallel test data is required (which may not be easy to design). Even if a parallel bypass mechanism is provided, a signifi cant increase in test time per test pattern will be inevitable, as analyzed in [Aerts 1998]. In the direct-access architecture, the available TAM wires are distributed

有若干种用户自定义的并行 TAM 配置。图 10.31 展示了其中四种：复用（multiplexed）、菊花链（daisy-chained）、直接访问（direct-access，即基于分配的（distribution-based））和本地控制（locally controlled）[Aerts 1998] [Waayers 2005]。在复用体系结构中，一次只有一个核能访问可用的 SOC TAM 连线，因此核间互连测试不易实现。在菊花链体系结构中，在一次测试会话期间所有核都能访问全部 TAM 连线，各核可被依次测试；然而，若只想同时访问其中一部分核，就需要一种旁路并行测试数据的机制（这可能不易设计）。即使提供了并行旁路机制，如 [Aerts 1998] 所分析的，每个测试向量的测试时间也不可避免地会显著增加。在直接访问体系结构中，可用的 TAM 连线被分布

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_474.jpg>)

- FIGURE 10.30

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_475.jpg>)  
Various architectures for parallel TAM.

并行 TAM 的各种体系结构。

over the wrapped cores. The optimal number of TAM wires to be assigned to a core depends on test requirements of the core (e.g., ATPG results and scan chain structure), and a test plan considering the requirements of all cores may be necessary in order to minimize the total test time. In the locally controlled TAM, a dedicated controller for each core is used, which allows the test procedures for all cores to be carried out simultaneously. This, however, requires tremendous hardware overhead.

到各个带外壳的核之上。分配给一个核的 TAM 连线数目多少最优，取决于该核的测试需求（例如 ATPG 结果和扫描链结构）；为了使总测试时间最小化，可能还需要一个兼顾所有核需求的测试方案。在本地控制的 TAM 中，每个核都使用一个专用的控制器，这使得所有核的测试过程可以同时进行；然而，这需要巨大的硬件开销。

Clearly, each of the above configurations has its own pros and cons. As a result, a combination of these configurations and TAM reconfigurations during testing is usually employed in a real system. For example, the Test Bus architecture presented in [Varma 1998] uses both the multiplexing and the distribution configurations. The TestRail proposed in [Marinissen 1998] can be connected in several ways following the daisy-chain configuration, the distribution-based architecture, or a combination of the two. Many test architecture design algorithms have been proposed to minimize the overall SOC test time for a given number of TAM wires by deter mining the number of distinct TAMs, their widths, and the assignment of these

显然，上述各种配置各有优劣。因此，实际的系统通常会把这几种配置组合起来使用，并在测试期间对 TAM 进行重构。例如，[Varma 1998] 提出的测试总线（Test Bus）体系结构就同时使用了复用和分配两种配置。[Marinissen 1998] 提出的 TestRail 则可以按照菊花链配置、基于分配的体系结构或两者的组合以多种方式连接。为了在给定 TAM 连线数目的条件下使 SOC 的整体测试时间最小化，人们已提出许多测试体系结构设计算法，用来确定不同 TAM 的数量、各自的宽度以及这些

TAMs to cores. For example, optimization for Test Bus architectures can be found in [Ivengar 2002], [Koranna 2002], and [Larsson 2002], whereas optimization of TestRail architectures is described in [Goel 2002] and [Goel 2003a]. Further dis cussion on the optimization of the wrapper and TAM design can be found in [Goel 2003b], [Sehgal 2004], and [Waayers 2005].

TAM 向各核的分配。例如，测试总线体系结构的优化可参见 [Ivengar 2002]、[Koranna 2002] 和 [Larsson 2002]，而 TestRail 体系结构的优化在 [Goel 2002] 和 [Goel 2003a] 中有描述。关于外壳与 TAM 设计优化的进一步讨论可参见 [Goel 2003b]、[Sehgal 2004] 和 [Waayers 2005]。

#### 10.4.7 Hierarchical Test Control and Plug-and-Play

Hierarchical design is a natural way to design a complex system starting from the behavioral or architectural level of description. Testing for a hierarchical core containing a number of internal cores may be achieved by flatting all cores during testing. This, however, may require significantly more routing area because the routing for testing is quite different from that for normal operation. On the other hand, the 1500 standard has been designed to accommodate the easy plug-and-play (PnP) of cores. Unless some test clocks (AUXCKn) and WBR are to be shared by some system functional operation, PnP of a core into a SOC should be readily applicable with the 1500 wrapper implemented in a flat design [IEEE 1500-2005]. To retain the PnP feature for a hierarchical core, however, is a nontrivial problem, as one has to enable the cores to be tested in addition to transferring test data between the SOC and the cores, preferably through the hierarchy. In this section,we describe three test architectures that deal with this problem [Benabdenbi 2000] [Lee 2000] [Li 2002].

层次化设计是从行为级或体系结构级描述出发设计复杂系统的一种自然方式。对包含若干内部核的层次化核进行测试，可以通过在测试期间将所有核展平来实现；然而，这可能需要多得多的布线面积，因为测试用布线与正常工作时的布线差别很大。另一方面，1500 标准在设计时就考虑到要让核能够方便地即插即用（plug-and-play, PnP）。只要某些测试时钟（AUXCKn）和 WBR 不被某些系统功能操作共享，在以扁平设计实现 1500 外壳的情况下，把核即插即用到 SOC 中应当是容易做到的 [IEEE 1500-2005]。然而，要让层次化核保持 PnP 特性却不是一件容易的事，因为除了要在 SOC 与各核之间传送测试数据之外，还必须使各核能够被启用以进行测试，而且最好经由层次结构完成。本节描述解决这一问题的三种测试体系结构 [Benabdenbi 2000] [Lee 2000] [Li 2002]。

In [Benabdenbi 2000], a test architecture called Core Access Switch (CAS) is proposed, where each core is wrapped by a 1500 wrapper and a CAS block is allocated to each core as shown in Figure 10.32. These CAS blocks are connected in series with N test signals, and a test controller is used to provide the N test signals to all CAS blocks (CAS 1, CAS 2,    ). Each CAS block can be operated in the configuration, bypass, or test mode, as shown in Figure 10.33. In the beginning of a test session, all CAS blocks are in the configuration mode, in which test instructions are sent to all CAS blocks and each CAS is configured to the required configuration

[Benabdenbi 2000] 提出了一种称为核访问开关（Core Access Switch, CAS）的测试体系结构，其中每个核都由一个 1500 外壳包裹，并且如图 10.32 所示为每个核分配一个 CAS 模块。这些 CAS 模块通过 N 条测试信号串联连接，并由一个测试控制器向所有 CAS 模块（CAS 1、CAS 2、……）提供这 N 条测试信号。如图 10.33 所示，每个 CAS 模块可以工作在配置（configuration）、旁路（bypass）或测试（test）模式。在一次测试会话开始时，所有 CAS 模块都处于配置模式：此时测试指令被发送到所有 CAS 模块，每个 CAS 被配置为所需的配置

according to the instruction it receives. When testing is carried out, each core is either in the bypass mode or in the test mode, as shown in Figure 10.33.

——依据的是其接收到的指令。当测试进行时，每个核要么处于旁路模式，要么处于测试模式，如图 10.33 所示。

For the test mode, CAS can support four test types according to the test requirements of the cores, as shown in Figure 10.34. Each CAS receives N test signals and converts them into P signals in one of the following ways:

对于测试模式，CAS 可以根据各核的测试需求支持四种测试类型，如图 10.34 所示。每个 CAS 接收 N 条测试信号，并以以下方式之一将其转换为 P 条信号：

\- For a core with k multiple scan chains, P k and test data are provided to the core through the k chains simultaneously.
\- 对于拥有 k 条多扫描链的核，P = k，测试数据通过这 k 条扫描链同时提供给核。

\- For a BISTed core, P can be as small as 1.
\- 对于采用 BIST 的核，P 可以小到 1。

\- For a core to be tested using external source and sink, P depends on the nature of the source and sink.
\- 对于要使用外部源和汇进行测试的核，P 取决于源和汇的性质。

\- For a hierarchical core, the CAS technique allows the internal cores to be CASed, and in this configuration P is equal to the width of the internal test bus.
\- 对于层次化核，CAS 技术允许对其内部核也配置 CAS，并且在这种配置下 P 等于内部测试总线的宽度。

In the last option, the CAS structure allows hierarchical cores to be tested with a single test controller. This poses a problem when the PnP feature in a hierarchical structure is considered. Referring to Figure 10.34, if the entire circuit is to be used

在最后一种方式中，CAS 结构使层次化核能够只用一个测试控制器来测试。但当考虑层次结构中的 PnP 特性时，这会带来一个问题。参见图 10.34，如果要把整个电路

as a core in a plug-and-play manner, the test controller in the circuit must also be included in the inner core; thus, one has to define how two test controllers at different hierarchical levels can cooperate in order to complete all test procedures. This appears to be quite difficult in the CAS structure. For the CAS design to achieve PnP in a hierarchical manner, no cores should be equipped with a test controller except for the core at the highest level.

以即插即用的方式用作一个核，那么电路中的测试控制器也必须包含在内部核中；于是，就必须定义不同层次级别上的两个测试控制器如何协作才能完成全部测试过程。这在 CAS 结构中似乎相当困难。要让 CAS 设计以层次化方式实现 PnP，除最高层的核之外，任何核都不应配备测试控制器。

In [Lee 2000] a hierarchical test architecture that does allow PnP of a hierar chical core is proposed. As shown in Figure 10.35, this architecture supports cores wrapped by the 1149.1 (JTAG) and 1500 (CTAG) standards. In addition, a hierarchical core can be plugged and played if it is wrapped by a proposed hierarchical core (H-core) wrapper. The H-core wrapper contains a center test controller (CTC), which consists of an 1149.1 TAP controller; a hierarchical test controller (HTC); and a programmable switch, as shown in Figure 10.36. The I/O of a hierarchical core contains the 5 required 1149.1 signals and 6 other signals (a total of 11 extra signals). The 6 extra signals are mainly used to enable cores through the hierarchy and provide test data and control signals similar to 1149.1 to the cores at the lower level.

[Lee 2000] 提出了一种确实能够对层次化核实现 PnP 的层次化测试体系结构。如图 10.35 所示，该体系结构支持由 1149.1（JTAG）和 1500（CTAG）标准包裹的核。此外，若层次化核由所提出的层次化核（H-core）外壳包裹，则它可以被即插即用。如图 10.36 所示，H-core 外壳包含一个中心测试控制器（center test controller, CTC），它由一个 1149.1 TAP 控制器、一个层次化测试控制器（hierarchical test controller, HTC）和一个可编程开关组成。层次化核的 I/O 包含 5 个必需的 1149.1 信号和 6 个其他信号（共 11 个额外信号）。这 6 个额外信号主要用于经由层次结构对各核进行启用，并向较低层次的核提供类似于 1149.1 的测试数据和控制信号。

The CTC is the mechanism used to select the cores to be tested and to distribute test signals to the selected cores. If a JTAG or CTAG core inside a hierarchical core is to be tested, then the upper-level controller will send the TAP control signals (TCS, including TCK, TRST, and TMS) to the hierarchical core. The CTC of the core will either distribute the signals directly to the JTAG core or convert the signals to wrapper control signals (WCSs) that are compatible with the CTAG core via the

CTC 是用来选择待测核并向所选核分配测试信号的机制。如果要测试层次化核内部的某个 JTAG 或 CTAG 核，上层控制器将把 TAP 控制信号（TCS，包括 TCK、TRST 和 TMS）发送给该层次化核。该核的 CTC 或者把这些信号直接分配给 JTAG 核，或者通过

A hierarchical test architecture supporting the plug-and-play feature.  
支持即插即用特性的层次化测试体系结构。

Detailed I/O and CTC of the hierarchical test architecture.

层次化测试体系结构的详细 I/O 与 CTC。

TAP controller of the CTC. If a hierarchical core inside a core is to be tested, then the upper-level controller will send the hierarchical control signals (HCSs) to the core and the CTC of the core will distribute the signals directly to the hierarchical core. The programmable switch block contains switches controlled by the HTC that will determine which cores are to be tested next and then set up the appropriate connections. The extra signals provided to the hierarchical cores allow the enabling of a core in a hierarchy directly from another core in an upper or lower level. This can save a lot of setup time when a new core in a hierarchy is to be tested as it is not necessary to send the new setup signals through cores outside the hierarchy. If a direct enabling of a core in a hierarchy is not considered, then these extra signals may not be necessary and fewer control signals can be used for implementing the PnP feature for a hierarchical core.

CTC 的 TAP 控制器，把这些信号转换为与 CTAG 核兼容的外壳控制信号（WCS）。如果要测试某个核内部的层次化核，上层控制器将把层次化控制信号（HCS）发送给该核，该核的 CTC 会把这些信号直接分配给该层次化核。可编程开关模块包含由 HTC 控制的开关，用于确定接下来要测试哪些核，然后建立相应的连接。提供给层次化核的这些额外信号，使得层次结构中的一个核可以直接由上层或下层的另一个核来启用。当层次结构中要测试一个新核时，这可以节省大量的建立时间，因为无需让新的建立信号穿过层次结构之外的核。如果不考虑对层次结构中核的直接启用，那么这些额外信号可能并非必需，并且可以用更少的控制信号来实现层次化核的 PnP 特性。

In Figure 10.37, a hierarchical test architecture with only five extra I/Os is proposed [Li 2002]. A hierarchical test manager (HTM) is used to generate the test signals required by a hierarchical core so as to handle the test operations at a lower level. Its upstream I/Os are compatible with the IEEE 1149.1 standard; that is, the I/Os consist of the serial test control signals (denoted as TCS\_UP and which include TCK\_UP, TMS\_UP, and TRST\_UP) and the serial test data signals (TDI\_UP and TDO\_UP). Its downstream I/Os consist of the 1500 control signals (PCS), TCS\_DN (including TCK\_DN, TMS\_DN, and TRST\_DN), the serial data I/Os (TDI\_H and TDO\_H) for the HTMs at the next level, and the serial data I/Os (TDI\_C and TDO\_C) for the cores at the same level. The TAM provides parallel test data transport capac ity for the 1500 and BISTed memory cores.

图 10.37 提出了一种只有 5 个额外 I/O 的层次化测试体系结构 [Li 2002]。层次化测试管理器（hierarchical test manager, HTM）用于生成层次化核所需的测试信号，以处理较低层次上的测试操作。其上游 I/O 与 IEEE 1149.1 标准兼容；也就是说，这些 I/O 由串行测试控制信号（记为 TCS\_UP，包括 TCK\_UP、TMS\_UP 和 TRST\_UP）和串行测试数据信号（TDI\_UP 和 TDO\_UP）组成。其下游 I/O 由 1500 控制信号（PCS）、TCS\_DN（包括 TCK\_DN、TMS\_DN 和 TRST\_DN）、供下一层次各 HTM 使用的串行数据 I/O（TDI\_H 和 TDO\_H），以及供同一层次各核使用的串行数据 I/O（TDI\_C 和 TDO\_C）组成。TAM 为 1500 核和采用 BIST 的存储器核提供并行的测试数据传输能力。

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_481.jpg>)  
A hierarchical test architecture with I/Os compatible with 1149.1.

I/O 与 1149.1 兼容的层次化测试体系结构。

When a hierarchical core is to be tested, the TCS\_DN of the upper-level HTM is encoded into the various required test signals (PCS and TCS\_DN) of the lower-level HTM. Also, the TDI\_H (TDO\_H) of the upper-level HTM is connected to TDI\_C (TDO\_C) or TDI\_H (TDO\_H) of the lower-level HTM, according to the types of cores to be tested. With this architecture, the hierarchical core test problem can be solved with a core I/O that is compatible with the 1149.1 standard.

当要测试一个层次化核时，上层 HTM 的 TCS\_DN 被编码为下层 HTM 所需的各种测试信号（PCS 和 TCS\_DN）。同时，根据待测核的类型，上层 HTM 的 TDI\_H（TDO\_H）连接到下层 HTM 的 TDI\_C（TDO\_C）或 TDI\_H（TDO\_H）。借助这种体系结构，层次化核的测试问题就可以用与 1149.1 标准兼容的核 I/O 来解决。

### 10.5 COMPARISONS BETWEEN THE 1500 AND 1149.1 STANDARDS

While 1500 is primarily targeted at core testing and 1149.1 at board-level test ing, the 1500 architecture was designed to allow interface compatibility with the IEEE 1149.1 test access port (TAP) controller from the beginning. The wrapper’s WSC interface signals can indeed be generated by the IEEE 1149.1 TAP controller except for the optional TransferDR signal. Thus, while the IEEE 1500 standard does not require or suggest it, the WSC interface may be controlled by an IEEE

虽然 1500 主要面向核测试，而 1149.1 主要面向板级测试，但 1500 体系结构从一开始就在设计上保证与 IEEE 1149.1 测试访问端口（TAP）控制器的接口兼容。事实上，除可选的 TransferDR 信号之外，外壳的 WSC 接口信号都可以由 IEEE 1149.1 TAP 控制器产生。因此，尽管 IEEE 1500 标准既不要求也不建议这样做，WSC 接口仍可以由一个 IEEE

TABLE 10.2 - Comparison between 1500 and 1149.1
表 10.2 - 1500 与 1149.1 的比较

<table><tr><td></td><td>1149.1</td><td>1500</td></tr><tr><td>Main objective<br>主要目标</td><td>Board-level testing<br>板级测试</td><td>Core-based testing<br>基于核的测试</td></tr><tr><td>Parallel mode<br>并行模式</td><td>No<br>否</td><td>Yes<br>是</td></tr><tr><td>Extra data/control I/Os<br>额外的数据/控制 I/O</td><td>Four mandatory (TMS, TCK, TDI, TDO) + one optional (TRST)<br>四个强制性的（TMS、TCK、TDI、TDO）+ 一个可选的（TRST）</td><td>Two mandatory (WSI, WSO) + six mandatory WSC + one optional (TransferDR) + optional AUXCKn(s) + optional WPP<br>两个强制性的（WSI、WSO）+ 六个强制性的 WSC + 一个可选的（TransferDR）+ 可选的 AUXCKn（一个或多个）+ 可选的 WPP</td></tr><tr><td>FSM (TAP controller)<br>FSM（TAP 控制器）</td><td>Yes<br>是</td><td>No<br>否</td></tr><tr><td>Transfer mode<br>传送模式</td><td>No<br>否</td><td>Optional<br>可选</td></tr><tr><td>Latency between Shift, Capture, and Update operations<br>移位、捕获与更新操作之间的延迟</td><td>Yes (e.g., two and a half cycles between Update and Capture)<br>是（例如更新与捕获之间间隔两个半周期）</td><td>No (due to the direct control of WSC)<br>否（由于 WSC 受直接控制）</td></tr><tr><td>Mandatory instructions<br>强制性指令</td><td>Four (EXTEST, BYPASS, PRELOAD, SAMPLE)<br>四个（EXTEST、BYPASS、PRELOAD、SAMPLE）</td><td>Two (WS_EXTEST, WS_BYPASS) + one Wx_INTEST + one conditionally required WS_PRELOAD<br>两个（WS_EXTEST、WS_BYPASS）+ 一个 Wx_INTEST + 一个有条件要求的 WS_PRELOAD</td></tr></table>

1149.1 TAP controller if the system integrator of an SOC wishes to do so in order to allow access to IEEE 1500 wrappers via the dedicated TAP pins on the SOC; however, there does exist a major difference between 1149.1 and 1500. With the direct application capability of the 1500 WSP protocol, delay testing can be achieved via executing a Capture event immediately after an Update or Transfer event, while the two and a half cycles of IEEE 1149.1 test clock (TCK) latency between the TAP’s UpdateDR and Capture-DR states limit the ability of the TAP protocol to execute some delay tests. Table 10.2 lists the main differences between the 1500 and 1149.1 standards.

1149.1 TAP 控制器来控制——前提是 SOC 的系统集成者希望这样做，以便经由 SOC 上专用的 TAP 引脚访问 IEEE 1500 外壳；然而，1149.1 与 1500 之间确实存在一个重大差异。凭借 1500 WSP 协议的直接施加能力，在一个更新（Update）或传送（Transfer）事件之后立即执行一个捕获（Capture）事件即可实现延迟测试；而 IEEE 1149.1 测试时钟（TCK）在 TAP 的 Update-DR 与 Capture-DR 状态之间存在两个半周期的延迟，这限制了 TAP 协议执行某些延迟测试的能力。表 10.2 列出了 1500 与 1149.1 标准之间的主要差异。

### 10.6 CONCLUDING REMARKS

This chapter focused on the 1149.1, 1149.6, and 1500 test standards. Test architectures to support these standards were also discussed. Currently, boundary scan is widely used throughout the industry; most commercial computer-aided test tools now provide automatic synthesis capability for boundary-scan design; the 1500 standard is new but is becoming popular in the SOC paradigm. Given the pervasiveness of the 1149.1 TAP, the expected popularity of 1500, and the ubiquity of internal scan and BIST test features, it seems natural to build upon the foundation of a boundary scan and 1500 to support TAP or wrapper-based access to internal chip/core test features in a standardized manner. A framework for the extension of the boundary scan standards has been launched by a working group called the Internal JTAG (IJTAG-IEEE P1687) [Rearick 2005].

本章重点讨论了 1149.1、1149.6 和 1500 三个测试标准，也讨论了支持这些标准的测试体系结构。当前，边界扫描在整个行业内得到广泛使用；大多数商用计算机辅助测试工具如今都能为边界扫描设计提供自动综合能力；1500 标准虽新，但在 SOC 领域正日益流行。鉴于 1149.1 TAP 的普遍存在、1500 的预期流行，以及内部扫描和 BIST 测试特性的无处不在，以边界扫描和 1500 为基础、以标准化的方式支持经由 TAP 或外壳访问芯片/核内部的测试特性，似乎是顺理成章的发展方向。一个用于扩展边界扫描标准的框架已由一个名为 Internal JTAG（IJTAG-IEEE P1687）的工作组启动 [Rearick 2005]。

Issues that were discussed but not fully addressed in this chapter include long test time, high test power, and the inefficiency of ATE. Many test scheduling algorithms that aim at minimizing test time for an SOC under various constraints such as limited TAM width, maximum allowable test power, test execution precedence, etc., have been proposed [Larsson 2002] [Ivengar 2002] [Zou 2003] [Rosinger 2005]. Recently, the concept of a test platform that makes use of the resources of an SOC such as embedded processors, memories, and bus structures to carry out on-chip, at-speed testing, has also been proposed to deal with the inefficiency problem of ATE [Huang 2001] [Tsai 2001] [Krstic 2002] [Tehranipour 2003] [Lee 2005].

本章讨论过但尚未完全解决的问题包括测试时间长、测试功耗高以及 ATE 效率低下。为了在各种约束（如受限的 TAM 宽度、最大允许测试功耗、测试执行的先后关系等）下使 SOC 的测试时间最小化，人们已提出许多测试调度算法 [Larsson 2002] [Ivengar 2002] [Zou 2003] [Rosinger 2005]。近来，为应对 ATE 效率低下的问题，还提出了测试平台的概念，即利用 SOC 自身的资源（如嵌入式处理器、存储器和总线结构）来执行片上 at-speed 测试 [Huang 2001] [Tsai 2001] [Krstic 2002] [Tehranipour 2003] [Lee 2005]。

## ANALOG AND MIXED-SIGNAL TESTING

Chauchin Su

National Chiao Tung University, Hsinchu, Taiwan

### ABOUT THIS CHAPTER

Analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits are becoming more critical in the systemon-chip (SOC) era, although they are occupying less silicon area. AMS circuits are designed using specialized techniques because a wide range of circuit structures are possible. Dedicated customization is required for various process technologies to satisfy performance requirements. Similarly, AMS testing depends strongly on the circuit and so depends on specialized approaches. This chapter introduces AMS circuits, failure modes, and fault models. It then addresses analog testing, including DC and AC parametric testing. Waveform-oriented testing and specification-oriented testing are considered. Then, mixed-signal circuits, analog-to-digital converters (ADCs), digital-to-analog converters (DACs), and their testing approaches, are discussed. Terminology and test approaches are consistent with the IEEE 1057 standard. Finally, the IEEE 1149.4 standard for mixed-signal test buses is studied. Two analog test buses are employed to deliver test stimuli and test responses in board-level analog interconnect testing and passive component measurement.

### 11.1 INTRODUCTION

Continuance and discreteness fundamentally distinguish analog from digital signals. Analog signals are continuous in time and amplitude, while digital signals are discrete in both domains. Additionally, digital signals are mostly binary, with $V _ { D D }$ for logical high and GND for logical low. Mixed signals are quantizations of analog signals. As digital signals, they are discrete in time and amplitude; however, they have a much higher amplitude resolution than digital signals. Figure 11.1 presents the waveforms of the three types of signals.

Due to the continuance property, analog circuits are commonly required to behave uniformly across their operational range; for example, the gain should be constant for various signal amplitudes within a particular range of frequencies. This property is referred to as linearity. Theoretically, as a real number, a continuous signal has an infinite resolution. Practically, such a requirement is excessive because a human cannot perceive infinitesimal variations; therefore, distortion and noise are introduced into the specification to allow some imperfection. The imperfection represents a gray area. It supports a tradeoff between cost and performance. Tradeoffs reduce the complexity of a particular design but enlarge the design space, meaning that more designs can be employed for a particular application; therefore, an analog design is specific to fine-grain applications so analog testing is used.

(a)  
![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_485.jpg>)

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_486.jpg>)  
(b)

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_487.jpg>)  
(c)  
Signals: (a) analog, (b) mixed-signal, and (c) digital.

Most digital function can be composed from a set of primitive gates such as NAND and NOR gates. Even though different circuit structures can be used to implement these gates, their inputs and outputs are the same in all cases. Analog circuits are designed using a totally different philosophy. Special circuit structures are required for particular applications; for example, an audio amplifier has high resolution and low bandwidth, and a video amplifier has low resolution and high bandwidth. A radiofrequency (RF) amplifier must satisfy totally different requirements related to impedance matching, noise figure, and power efficiency. Analog and mixed-signal designs and testing involve particular approaches; in other words, different design and test methodologies are required for different analog circuits.

#### 11.1.1 Analog Circuit Properties

The fundamental difference between analog and digital signals has now been out lined. Now, let us consider the detailed properties of circuits that influence their design and testing. Important analog properties are listed below.

\- Continuous signals

\- Large range of circuits

\- Nonlinear characteristics

\- Feedback ambiguity

\- Complicated cause–effect relationship

\- Absence of suitable fault model

\- Accurate measurements required

Different interpretations of a step response: (a) digital, and (b) analog.

##### 11.1.1.1 Continuous Signals

Analog signals are continuous. The interpretations of a particular waveform plotted in Figure 11.2 differ with the domain: digital or analog. For a digital waveform, the useful specifications are logical high and low voltages $( V _ { H }$ and $V _ { L } )$ and rise and fall times $( t _ { L H }$ and $t _ { H L } )$ . For an analog waveform, they are amplitude $( V _ { A } )$ , slew rate (SR), overshoot $( V _ { o \nu } )$ , settling time $( t _ { S e t t l e } )$ , bandwidth, phase, and others; therefore, more parameters must be considered in the analog domain.

##### 11.1.1.2 Large Range ofCircuits

Analog circuits include generic modules such as operational amplifiers, filters, comparators, regulators, mixers, low noise amplifiers, power amplifiers, and switches. Specialized modules include line drivers, variable gain amplifiers, oscillators, sensors, and RF transceivers, among many others. Their functions and specifications differ significantly. For each circuit, their particular characteristics must be considered; therefore, analog testing is knowledge intensive.

##### 11.1.1.3 Nonlinear Characteristics

Analog active devices are nonlinear; for example, large signal models of diodes, bipolar transistors, and MOS transistors are all nonlinear:

$$
I _ {D} = I _ {s} \cdot e ^ {V _ {D} / n \times V _ {T}}\tag{11.1}
$$

$$
I _ {C} = I _ {s} \cdot e ^ {V _ {B E} / V _ {T}}\tag{11.2}
$$

$$
I _ {D} = \frac {1}{2} \mu C _ {o x} \frac {W}{L} (V _ {g s} - V _ {t}) ^ {2}\tag{11.3}
$$

A desired biasing current can be obtained by solving nonlinear equations to determine a suitable biasing voltage. Although they are globally nonlinear, they are approximately linear within a small operating range. Such a model is referred to as a small signal model. Notably, the parameters of the linear model depend on the

![](<assets/VLSI Test Principles and Architectures(MinerU)/image_488.jpg>)  
(a)  
(b)

- FIGURE 11.2

bias. For example, the transconductance of a MOS transistor is $g _ { m } = \sqrt { 2 \mu C _ { o x } \frac { W } { L } I _ { D } }$ Additionally, the second-order effects, including the body effect, channel length modulation, mobility variation, subthreshold, hot electrons, and others, further complicate the situation.

##### 11.1.1.4 Feedback Ambiguity

Analog circuits use feedback extensively to increase linearity; for example, for an operational amplifier in the inverting configuration, as presented in Figure 11.3, the closed-loop gain is $A _ { f } = \frac { - A } { 1 + \frac { R 1 } { R 2 } A }$ , where A is the open-loop gain. If A is sufficiently large, then the closed-loop gain approximates $\begin{array} { r } { A _ { f } = - \frac { R 2 } { R 1 } } \end{array}$ , a constant. However, when the closed-loop gain is less than the specified value, determining whether R1 is too large, R2 is too small, or A is too small, is difficult. A similar feedback scheme applies to a phase-locked loop (PLL), automatic gain control (AGC), power regulators, and others. More tests must be conducted to identify faulty components.

##### 11.1.1.5 Complicated Cause–Effect Relationship

Nonlinearity and feedback complicate the cause–effect relationship. Many circuit parameters associated with a signal parameter also complicate the cause–effect relationship. Any single device failure will influence, if not all, most of the circuit and signal parameters. So, any circuit or signal parameter failure can be caused by the failure of any device; therefore, fault-specific test generation is more difficul than for digital counterparts. Specification-oriented testing is still more popular than other forms of testing, despite its being costly and time consuming.

##### 11.1.1.6 Absence ofSuitable Fault Model

In digital testing, the single-fault assumption has attracted consensus in the test community because it is simple and effective. It might not be sufficiently accurate for deep-submicron circuits, but it is satisfactory, considering the complexity of other, more accurate fault models. No simple and effective nor generic and generally acceptable analog fault model is available, because the range of circuits is large.
